author: Jack Baer
title: MLB and players union exchange barbs over pitch clock after brutal run of pitcher injuries - Yahoo Sports
mainText: The Major League Baseball (MLB) and the players' union are currently in a heated exchange over the pitch clock, following a series of severe pitcher injuries. The Cleveland Guardians began the day by announcing that their former Cy Young Award winner, Shane Bieber, will undergo Tommy John surgery, effectively ending his season. Shortly after, it was announced that Spencer Strider, the ace of the Atlanta Braves, also has damage in his UCL, although the team is seeking a second opinion on surgery. These are just the latest in a string of pitcher injuries this year, with Gerrit Cole, Eury Perez, Lucas Giolito, and others all sidelined to varying degrees. The situation has become so dire that as of Saturday, only two former Cy Young Award winners, Corbin Burnes and Blake Snell, were on an active MLB roster. Tony Clark, the executive director of the MLB Players Association, believes that the new pitch clock and the modifications made for this season are to blame. Despite unanimous player opposition and significant health and safety concerns, the Commissioner's Office reduced the length of the Pitch Clock last December. Since then, concerns about the health impacts of reduced recovery time have only intensified. The league's unwillingness to acknowledge or study the effects of these profound changes is an unprecedented threat to our game and its most valuable asset — the Players. However, MLB responded by claiming that empirical evidence shows the pitch clock isn't to blame and that the spate of pitcher injuries could be blamed on broader trends.

author: Akshit Bhatnagar
title: RR vs RCB: 14-year-old kid breaches security, runs on field to hug Virat Kohli as video goes viral - CricTracker
mainText: The T20 Cricket match between Rajasthan Royals (RR) and Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) took place on Saturday, April 6, 2024, at Sawai Mansingh Stadium in Jaipur. This match was the 19th game of the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2024 season. The toss was won by RR, who chose to field first. In the first inning, RCB scored 183 runs for the loss of 3 wickets in their allotted 20 overs. Virat Kohli was the star performer, smashing 113 runs off 72 balls with 12 fours and 4 sixes. Faf du Plessis contributed 44 runs in 33 balls with 2 fours and 2 sixes. Glenn Maxwell and Sachin Chauhan also made valuable contributions. In response, RR chased down the target with 189 runs for the loss of 4 wickets in 19.1 overs. Jos Buttler played a sensational innings, scoring 100 runs off 58 balls, including 9 fours and 4 sixes. Sanju Samson added 69 runs in 42 balls with 8 fours and 2 sixes. RR secured victory by 6 wickets. Jos Buttler’s outstanding century earned him the Player of the Match award. The thrilling encounter was further highlighted by a 14-year-old kid who breached security and ran onto the field to hug Virat Kohli, capturing hearts and creating a viral moment.

author: Mike Florio
title: More than 40000 show up for St. Louis Battlehawks home opener - NBC Sports
mainText: The United Football League (UFL) should have had its opening game in St. Louis. The Battlehawks’ home opener happened in Week 2. St. Louis set an attendance record for post-Rams football, with 40,317 to watch their game against the Arlington Renegades. Whether it’s because folks in St. Louis love their local teams or want to give a lingering middle finger to Stan Kroenke or some of both, people are going to see the Battlehawks play. The prior record was set on March 12, 2023, with 38,310. St. Louis is doing far better than Memphis, where only 8,791 showed up for Saturday’s home opener against the San Antonio Brahmas. If the UFL is going to thrive, it needs more cities to take to their teams the way St. Louis has taken to the Battlehawks. Maybe the UFL should target other cities the NFL has left, like San Diego and Oakland and perhaps in time Kansas City. Record crowd shows up for UFL home opener in the Rams' former city.

author: Grumpy_Opa_Takes
title: Bayern Munich must overcome issues to qualify for the Champions League - Bavarian Football Works
mainText: Bayern Munich's striker, Harry Kane, continued his record-breaking scoring run in Germany by netting twice in their 4-2 victory over Heidenheim. This win has provisionally lifted Bayern Munich to the top spot in the Bundesliga. Kane, who has now scored 21 goals in 15 matches in the Bundesliga and the Champions League for Bayern, opened his account in the 14th minute with a superb turn and shot in the box from a Leroy Sane pass. He then struck again with a powerful header a minute before the break after yet another Sane assist. He is now the first player in Bundesliga history to score 17 goals in the first 11 matchdays of a season. Kane had scored back-to-back hat-tricks in the league against Darmstadt 98 and last week’s 4-0 demolition of Borussia Dortmund before netting twice more in their mid-week Champions League win over Galatasaray. He now has more league goals after 11 league matches than last season’s top Bundesliga scorers had in the entire 2022-23 campaign, with questions about whether he can break the league record of 41 goals now almost inevitable.

author: MLB.com
title: Oneil Cruz hits walk-off single in Pirates' extra innings win - MLB.com
mainText: Oneil Cruz, the star player of the Pittsburgh Pirates, was the hero of the day as he hit a walk-off single in the 11th inning of the game against the Baltimore Orioles. This led the Pirates to a 5-4 victory. Cruz's throw in the ninth inning was instrumental in keeping the game tied and pushing it into extra innings. The game was far from perfect for the Pirates as they lost a 3-0 lead late in the game and fell behind in the extra innings. However, they managed to fight back and secure a win at PNC Park. Cruz's performance was particularly noteworthy as he not only helped keep the game alive but also delivered the winning hit. The Pirates' battery also had a good day with Bailey Falter making a strong comeback from his previous outing and Joey Bart hitting a home run in his first swing as a Pirate. Despite some hiccups from the bullpen and a wild pitch that allowed the Orioles to tie the game, the Pirates held on and even had a chance to walk it off in the 10th inning. However, they only managed to score one run on an Edward Olivares walk. The 11th inning saw Josh Fleming and Luis Ortiz hold the Orioles to a zero, setting the stage for Cruz to bring home the victory. This win marks the Pirates' third extra-inning win in their 7-2 start to the season, a feat that has only been achieved by 12 teams since 1906 in their first nine games. The Pirates are the first team to do so since 1920.

author: Ryan Divish
title: Bryce Miller spins gem, Mariners stifle late drama to beat Brewers - The Seattle Times
mainText: Bryce Miller, the starting pitcher for the Seattle Mariners, put on a stellar performance in their game against the Milwaukee Brewers. His excellent pitching was a key factor in the Mariners' 5-3 victory. Despite a strong lead and a seemingly assured win, the Mariners found themselves in a tense situation towards the end of the game. Andres Muñoz, who had a disappointing performance the previous day, was back on the mound with the Mariners leading by two runs in the bottom of the ninth. This time, however, he did not allow any walks or baserunners. He secured two groundball outs and struck out Jackson Chourio, ensuring the Mariners' victory. Bryce Miller's performance was particularly impressive. He pitched seven scoreless innings, allowing only three hits and one walk, and striking out seven. He was also highly efficient, throwing just 78 pitches, 53 of which were strikes. He threw first-pitch strikes to 17 of the 25 batters he faced. However, after seven innings, the Mariners' manager, Scott Servais, decided to bring in the bullpen, despite leading 4-0. The relievers, Austin Voth and Gabe Speier, struggled and gave up three runs in the eighth inning. Despite these challenges, the Mariners managed to hold on and secure their victory. This win is the Mariners' third extra-inning win in their 7-2 start to the season, a feat achieved by only 12 teams since 1906 in their first nine games. The Mariners are the first team to do so since 1920.

author: Jonathan Noble
title: Suzuka chicane struggles leaves Ferrari F1 team scratching its head - Motorsport.com
mainText: Ferrari's F1 team is seeking answers as to why one of its key car strengths seems to have disappeared at the Formula 1’s Japanese Grand Prix. The team from Maranello had anticipated that the improvements made to its SF-24 this year would enable it to pose a serious challenge to Red Bull around the high-speed bends of Suzuka. However, with the current generation of F1 cars, teams are facing an ongoing challenge in trying to balance the need for downforce at a range of speeds. This could be a reason why Ferrari’s performance has dipped. Despite Red Bull's dominance at Suzuka, Carlos Sainz believes that more victories for Ferrari are not out of the question. Sainz arrived at Suzuka in high spirits after leading his teammate Charles Leclerc to a 1-2 finish at the Australian GP. However, Ferrari had a more difficult time in the fight for grid positions, with Sainz finishing fourth on the grid, 0.485 seconds behind pole position man Max Verstappen. Leclerc qualified eighth.

author: Detroit Free Press
title: Detroit Pistons fall apart late at Nets, 113-103, despite solid shooting; injury list grows - Detroit Free Press
mainText: The Detroit Pistons were not satisfied with their performance level after a disappointing 18-point loss to the Memphis Grizzlies. However, they should have been more content with their response in the following game. Despite leading by 19 points with less than 8 minutes remaining in the second quarter, a late collapse resulted in another loss. The Pistons fell to the Brooklyn Nets, 113-103. Brooklyn ended the fourth quarter with a 19-0 run. Detroit's last bucket was at the 5:07 mark of the fourth. The Pistons lost despite having their best shooting night in weeks. They hit 17 of their 37 attempts from 3, and forced 18 Brooklyn turnovers. It was undone by a fourth quarter in which they were outscored by 18 points, including the 19-0 run to close the night. Chimezie Metu led the Pistons with 20 points on 9-for-9 shooting. Marcus Sasser (18 points), Jaden Ivey (16 points, 10 assists), Troy Brown Jr. (15 points) and Jaylen Nowell (12 points) all reached double-figures. Cam Thomas led all scorers with 32 points. The Pistons’ injury report grew again before the game, as Jalen Duren was ruled out with left ankle soreness and Evan Fournier was also a scratch with right knee soreness. Two-way forward Tosan Evbuomwan is also out for the rest of the season, due to him hitting his 50-game limit. The collective bargaining agreement states that two-way players are only eligible to be active for 50 regular season games. They join a list that already includes Cade Cunningham, Ausar Thompson, Isaiah Stewart, Simone Fontecchio, Quentin Grimes and Stanley Umude. Taj Gibson returned from a nine-game absence due to a hamstring strain.

author: Rapid Recap Team
title: Top-ranked Korda cruises to T-Mobile Match Play final and will face Maguire - LPGA
mainText: Nelly Korda, the world's top-ranked player, raced out to an early lead and beat Narin An 4 and 3 in the semifinals of the T-Mobile Match Play. This victory puts her a match away from her fourth straight LPGA Tour victory. Korda will play against Leona Maguire in the final on Sunday. Korda is trying to become the first LPGA Tour player to win four consecutive starts since Lorena Ochoa in 2008. The record is five, set by Nancy Lopez in 1978 and matched by Annika Sorenstam in 2004-05. Korda took seven weeks off including the Asian part of the schedule after winning in January in her hometown of Bradenton, Florida. That means a victory this weekend would be her third consecutive in a scheduled event. Four players share the record of four straight, with Mickey Wright doing it twice. Should Korda win, she will have the chance to equal that record in two weeks at The Chevron Championship, the year's first major.

author: Peter
title: Deals: Amazon drops the prices of the iPhone 15 whole series, iPhone 14 and 14 Plus too - GSMArena.com news - GSMArena.com
mainText: Amazon has recently reduced the prices of the entire iPhone 15 series, as well as the iPhone 14 and 14 Plus. This is a significant change as it's been a while since Amazon had such attractive offers on iPhones. In February, the iPhone 15 was priced at €790 for a 128GB unit and €950 for a 256GB one. The prices have returned to around the same range, but the rest of the 15-series is now also discounted. The iPhone 15 Plus, which is now under €1,000, offers a large screen for €375 less than the Pro Max version. Despite its 6.7” OLED display running at only 60Hz, it features the Dynamic Island instead of the outdated notch. It also comes with a high-resolution main camera (48MP) and USB-C with video out. The iPhone 15 Pro is still priced above €1,000, but the discount looks appealing considering that Apple still charges €1,200 for it. The Pros do have 120Hz displays (LTPO panels) and dedicated telephoto cameras – 12MP 3x in this case. The Pro Max is Apple’s best offering, including a 120mm periscope (5x, 12MP sensor) for the best zoom yet, at least on the iOS side of the fence. The 15 Pro Max and 15 Plus have excellent battery life – our tests report 16:01h and 16:33h active use ratings, respectively. If you're considering going back a generation, especially for more storage, the iPhone 14 starts at €700. While the jump to 256GB is fairly pricey, it’s still less than the 15 256GB. The iPhone 14 Plus keeps it under €1,000 even in the 256GB trim. Note that the 14 series still use 12MP main cameras, notched displays, and Lightning ports. The budget option is still the iPhone SE from 2022. This will be the last hurrah for the iPhone 6-8 design with the TouchID Home button and chunky bezels around an IPS LCD. The upcoming SE (expected later this year) should switch to an iPhone 14 design (and OLED display), which also means that it will be physically larger too. As an alternative, the Samsung Galaxy S23 is sticking around to offer Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (for Galaxy) in a land used to Exynos chips inside the S-series. It’s 25% off its MSRP and the 256GB version is only €20 more – well worth the price, considering that Samsung dropped the microSD a long time ago.

author: TOI Tech Desk
title: Blinkit customer demands to play FIFA with delivery partner, here’s what CEO Albinder Dhindsa said - The Times of India
mainText: Blinkit, the quick commerce platform, recently made an announcement that it will deliver the newly launched Sony PlayStation 5 Slim edition to your doorstep within just 10 minutes. The gaming console will be available for customers to order on its app. Albinder Dhindsa, the CEO of the company, announced on social media platform X (formerly known as Twitter) that customers will be able to order both variants of the PS5 Slim consoles through its app. As per the company's tagline, once ordered, Blinkit is expected to deliver the new consoles to the customer's doorstep within 10 minutes. Following this announcement, Blinkit received an unusual request from a customer. The customer suggested an unconventional idea of turning a regular delivery into a gaming session by arranging a PlayStation 5 play date with the delivery agent. This incident took place when the customer approached Blinkit's customer support team with their unique demand. The company, owned by Zomato, shared the screenshot of the chat between the user and the customer chat support. The user shared a screenshot indicating that they would only order the PS 5 through the app under a specific condition. When asked about this condition, the customer responded, "Only if the rider stays back and plays FIFA with me." He also added, "I need someone to practice with to beat my friends later." This humorous interaction caught the attention of the Blinkit CEO Albinder Dhindsa and he reacted with a face-palm emoji. The PS5 Slim models are available in two variations: the digital edition and the disc version, priced at Rs 44,990 and Rs 54,990 respectively. These redesigned consoles come with increased storage, a more compact design, and similar hardware to the standard models. Sony has managed to reduce the overall volume of the new consoles by up to 30% and their weight by up to 24% compared to the current models. The modular design of the latest console will allow users to easily upgrade them. Additionally, Sony will provide the option to add a disc drive as an accessory to the digital edition with the PS5 Slim models.

author: ET Telecom
title: AI can drive efficiency, but raises mkt concentration concerns: Competition Commission chief - ETTelecom
mainText: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to enhance efficiency across various sectors, but it also raises concerns about market concentration. The Competition Commission of India’s (CCI) Chairperson, Ashok Kumar Gupta, highlighted these dual aspects during a recent discussion. While AI can drive productivity and streamline processes, there is a need to address the potential for monopolistic behavior and market dominance by a few large players. Gupta emphasized that competition authorities must closely monitor the impact of AI on market dynamics and ensure a level playing field for all participants. As AI adoption accelerates, striking the right balance between efficiency gains and competitive fairness becomes crucial for regulatory bodies. The article delves into the delicate balance between AI-driven efficiency and the need to prevent anti-competitive practices, shedding light on the evolving landscape in India’s business and technology sectors.

author: HT Tech
title: When will Apple unveil the 2024 iPad Pro? Latest updates revealed - HT Tech
mainText: Apple's new iPad Pro models, which are expected to be the most significant update since 2018, are facing delays in their release due to various development and production challenges. The release of the new iPad Pro and iPad Air models, initially expected in March or April, has been postponed due to hardware and software bottlenecks, particularly in finalizing the upcoming iPadOS 17.4 software update. The new iPad Pros are expected to feature OLED screens, a significant departure from previous models, which has added to the complexities and delays in production. Recent reports suggest that the launch of the new iPad Pro and iPad Air is now slated for early May. However, production of the 11-inch iPad Pro appears to be lagging behind its 12.9-inch counterpart, potentially resulting in limited availability upon launch. Despite the delay, the new iPad Pros are expected to offer a host of exciting features and improvements, including OLED screens, a thinner design, upgraded performance with an M3 chip, and a new Magic Keyboard accessory. All signs point to an imminent launch within the next several weeks.

author: HT Tech
title: iPhone hacking price list: Here’s how much hackers charge for zero-day iOS exploits - HT Tech
mainText: The market for zero-day exploits is flourishing, with prices for hacks targeting iPhones, iMessage, and more reaching new heights. Crowdfense, a startup that specializes in buying and reselling zero-day vulnerabilities, recently disclosed its latest pricing list, which shows astonishing amounts for exploits targeting iPhones, iMessage, and more. According to Crowdfense's pricing list, it will pay between $5 and $7 million for zero-days that can penetrate iPhones, while Android exploits can earn up to $5 million. Exploits that target popular web browsers and messaging platforms are also highly valued, with vulnerabilities in Google Chrome and Safari fetching up to $3 million and $3.5 million, respectively, and hacks for iMessage and WhatsApp earning between $3 and $5 million. These figures represent a significant increase from Crowdfense's previous pricing, reflecting the growing demand for advanced hacking tools. The rise in prices can be attributed to the enhanced security measures implemented by tech giants like Apple and Google, which have led hackers to search for increasingly scarce and elusive vulnerabilities. While Crowdfense's payouts are among the highest in the industry, other entities, particularly in Russia, offer even more attractive rewards. Last year, a Russian company named Operation Zero announced plans to pay up to $20 million for iPhone and Android exploits, although geopolitical tensions and sanctions may affect the availability of such deals. Despite the tempting payouts offered by third-party brokers, tech companies like Apple also run their own bug bounty programs. For example, Apple's Security Research Bounty program offers rewards of up to $2 million for critical security vulnerabilities discovered in its products. The rising prices for zero-day exploits highlight the changing landscape of cybersecurity, where the competition to discover and exploit vulnerabilities is driven by both financial incentives and geopolitical interests. As technology continues to evolve, the need for effective cybersecurity measures and ethical hacking practices becomes increasingly important in protecting digital ecosystems from malicious actors.

author: HT Tech
title: Google Wallet gets a new setting for Automatically add linked passes”- Here’s how it works - HT Tech
mainText: Google Wallet has introduced a new feature called "Automatically add linked passes". This feature, found in the "Passes" sub-section of Google Wallet settings on Android, allows pass providers to automatically add related event tickets, promotions, offers, and more to existing passes. This feature is enabled by default and is designed to enhance the user experience by integrating additional passes into the wallet seamlessly. The "Auto Linked Pass" will be grouped with the primary pass, and users will be informed of the new addition with a clear callout above it. This feature supports various pass types, including Event, Boarding, Transit, Offer, Gift card, Loyalty, and Generic passes. The potential applications of this feature are diverse and practical. For instance, users can link offers to existing loyalty cards, meal vouchers to boarding passes or event tickets, and parking passes to event tickets, among other possibilities. While the automatic addition of linked passes offers convenience, there are concerns about potential cluttering of the pass list with unwanted promotions and offers. To address this, users have the option to disable the auto behavior, giving them control over their pass management. The introduction of the "Automatically add linked passes" setting is part of Google Wallet version 24.10.x and appears to be more widely rolled out compared to previous settings updates. As users explore this new feature, Google aims to ensure that it enhances convenience without overwhelming users with unnecessary pass additions.

author: Rapid Recap Team
title: 2024 solar eclipse: The best apps to help view the celestial event - The Boston Globe
mainText: The 2024 solar eclipse is expected to be the most-watched celestial event in our lifetime. To help you, the Boston Globe has put together a list of apps for both iOS and Android devices that will show you what to expect on eclipse day, teach you more about the eclipse, and offer crucial information for tracking the path of total darkness. These apps can help you understand and appreciate the solar eclipse, whether you're an experienced stargazer or a casual observer. They provide a wealth of information, including the timing of the eclipse, the path it will take, and safety tips for viewing it. Some apps even offer interactive features that allow you to simulate the eclipse from your location. So, whether you plan to travel to the path of totality or watch the eclipse from your backyard, these apps can enhance your experience of this extraordinary celestial event.

author: Victor
title: Google's new JPEG image encoder offers higher quality and saves on size and bandwidth - GSMArena.com news - GSMArena.com
mainText: Google has introduced a new JPEG image encoder that promises to deliver higher quality images while saving on size and bandwidth. This new encoder, named jpegli, is a JPEG coding library that includes both an encoder and a decoder. The most significant aspect of jpegli is that it complies with the original JPEG standard and its most conventional 8-bit formalism. This means that images encoded using jpegli are compatible with existing decoders like your browser or image viewer of choice. Jpegli uses adaptive quantization to reduce noise and improve image quality by spatially modulating the dead zone in quantization based on psychovisual modeling. The benefits of jpegli are quite impressive. It compresses images around 35% more than traditional JPEG codecs while maintaining their visual quality. This could result in significant savings in online bandwidth. Furthermore, jpegli performs more precise and psychovisually effective computations, making images look clearer and have fewer observable artifacts. It can also encode images with 10+ bits per component compared to the 8 bits of traditional JPEG coding solutions. This happens in the original 8-bit formalism without breaking compatibility with traditional 8-bit viewers while reducing visible banding artifacts in slow gradients. Lastly, jpegli is comparable in speed to other coding libraries, so it won't require any additional computational resources or slow down processes. Google has already published the full jpegli source code on GitHub for anyone interested to check out and potentially start using it today.

author: Tech Desk
title: Apple allows retro console game emulators on App Store, but there’s a catch - The Indian Express
mainText: Apple has made a significant change to its App Store policies, now allowing developers to create emulators for retro console games. This move comes with the added ability for these emulators to download files. However, Apple has made it clear that developers must adhere to copyright laws, indicating that apps enabling users to download pirated games may face bans. Additionally, these retro console emulators are required to utilize in-app purchases for the acquisition of digital items. This policy change appears to be a response to a recent antitrust lawsuit filed against Apple by the United States, accusing the tech giant of monopolistic practices. Android users have had access to retro game emulators for years, but Apple had previously actively prevented such emulators from being available on the App Store. This recent policy change by Apple may encourage developers to create these emulators, potentially opening up a new revenue stream. Earlier this year, Apple made changes to its rules to comply with the European Union’s Digital Markets Act (DMA), announcing that it would allow streaming game stores worldwide. The company also updated the App Store rules to support in-app purchases for AI chatbots and some mini-games. In addition to game emulators, Apple appears to have made changes to rules regarding super apps like WeChat, stating that mini-games within these apps should now use HTML5 and cannot be treated as native apps or games.

author: Ankur Mishra
title: Waiting For Motorola Edge 50 Pro Sale? Flipkart Reveals Limited Time Deal Starting April 8 - Zee News
mainText: Motorola has recently launched its latest flagship smartphone, the Motorola Edge 50 Pro, in India. This new device is a successor to the Motorola Edge 40 Pro that was launched last year. The Motorola Edge 50 Pro is available in three color options: Moon Light Pearl, Luxe Lavender, and Black Beauty. A limited-time deal on the Moon Light Pearl variant of the Motorola Edge 50 Pro smartphone will start on April 8 at 7:00 PM via Flipkart. However, the Motorola Edge 50 Pro, which is an IP68-rated smartphone, will go on sale starting April 9 via Flipkart, Motorola.in, and all leading retail stores. The base variant of the Motorola Edge 50 Pro with 8 GB RAM and 256 GB storage is priced at Rs 31,999, which includes a 68W charger. The 12 GB RAM with 256 GB variant carries a price tag of Rs 35,999, which includes a 125 W charger. There is an instant discount of Rs 2,250 on HDFC Bank card holders and an additional Rs 2,000 discount as an exchange bonus. For early birds, the company is offering a discount for a limited period of time at which the 8GB RAM variant is available for users at Rs 27,999 and the 12GB variant at Rs 31,999. The new smartphone features a stunning 6.7-inch 1.5K pOLED curved display with a remarkable 144Hz refresh rate, HDR10+, and an impressive 2,000 nits of peak brightness. The handset is powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 7 Gen 3 chipset and is loaded with a 4,500mAh battery supported by 125W TurboPower charging technology and 50W wireless charging. The smartphone comes with a 50 MP primary sensor, a versatile 13 MP ultra-wide-angle/macro lens, and a 10 MP telephoto lens with 3x optical zoom. For selfies and video chats, there is a high-resolution 50 MP front camera with autofocus support. The smartphone is backed by Moto Ai, the camera delivers exceptional performance in both photography and videography. The smartphone houses a Dolby Atmos, dual stereo speakers, an in-display fingerprint sensor.

author: ABP News Bureau
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch FE Might Be Launched Soon, Model Numbers Surface On IMEI Database: Report - ABP Live
mainText: Recent reports suggest that Samsung is preparing to launch a new version of its Galaxy Watch, known as the Galaxy Watch FE (Fan Edition). This upcoming smartwatch is expected to be equipped with Google's Wear OS operating system, in line with Samsung's aim to offer users a cost-effective yet feature-packed wearable experience. The Galaxy Watch FE is likely to have similar specifications to an older Galaxy Watch model, but at a more affordable price. These reports also suggest that Samsung's Galaxy Watch FE will be launched before July, possibly before the highly anticipated Galaxy Watch 7 series is introduced. Notably, information from an IMEI database has revealed three distinct model numbers for the Galaxy Watch FE: SM-R866F for the global version, SM-R866U for the US market, and SM-R866N for South Korea. This indicates that Samsung is making a concerted effort to cater to different consumer preferences in various markets. Comparisons between the speculated model number SM-R866F and the existing SM-R860F model used for the Samsung Galaxy Watch 4 provide insights into the expected features of the Galaxy Watch FE. It is expected that the Galaxy Watch FE will use the Wear OS platform to provide an intuitive and seamless user experience. Furthermore, powered by the Exynos W920 chip, this upcoming smartwatch is expected to offer excellent performance and functionality, reinforcing Samsung's commitment to innovation in the wearable technology sector. Information about the speculated Galaxy Watch FE, including crucial details such as its hardware specifications and pricing, remains elusive. If it comes to fruition, this smartwatch could position itself as Samsung's most affordable offering, running on Wear OS and embodying the design ethos of the Galaxy Watch 4. A similar strategy can be seen in Apple's Watch SE lineup, where fewer features are offered at a more accessible price point. Although Samsung has not officially confirmed the potential launch of a new Galaxy Watch FE, industry observers anticipate that the device, if indeed in development, will be launched in the near future.

author: TOI Tech Desk
title: What is Snapchat's ‘Solar System’ feature and why Snap is disabling it: Read the company’s message - The Times of India
mainText: Snapchat's Solar System feature, which was available to paid subscribers, provided a visual representation of the user's interaction frequency with their Snapchat friends in the form of a solar system. For instance, a friend who the user interacts with frequently would be placed in the 'Mercury' position, while a friend with whom the user has less frequent interactions would be placed in the 'Uranus' position. However, this feature has been reported to contribute to anxiety among teenagers. In response to these concerns, Snapchat has modified the feature. The company has stated that while they understand that the Solar System feature can exacerbate feelings of anxiety, they do not want to contribute to such feelings. As a result, the Solar System feature will now be turned off by default. However, Snapchat+ subscribers will have the option to enable the feature if they wish. The company hopes that this change will strike a balance between providing a feature that many users enjoy while avoiding upsetting those who do not wish to use it. It's worth noting that the Solar System feature is not widely used, with less than 0.25% of the community's paid members using the option. Despite this, Snapchat maintains that features like the Solar System provide valuable insights and context about friendships. The company has also expressed its commitment to mitigating the potential downsides of online communication wherever possible. The Solar System feature has also been associated with the 'friend ranking problem', where users are unable to see who is closer or further away from a friend as they are. This has led to difficult conversations and even breakups in some cases when others discover that they are not the number one friend in the user's solar system.

author: ABP News Bureau
title: WhatsApp New Feature: Users Might Soon Be Able To Tag Their Contacts In Status Update Privately - ABP Live
mainText: WhatsApp is reportedly working on a new feature that will allow users to privately tag contacts in their status updates. This feature is similar to how users can mention others in their Instagram stories. The tagged contacts will not be visible to other viewers, ensuring privacy. However, the tagged contacts will receive a notification, informing them about the mention and encouraging interaction. This update aims to enhance interaction and provide users with more ways to share important moments directly with selected individuals. Users tagged in updates can respond, react, or engage in conversations, creating a more dynamic and interactive environment within WhatsApp status updates. The new feature, which is currently in the development stage, is expected to make WhatsApp Statuses more engaging and interactive. This feature was recently discovered in the WhatsApp beta for Android version 2.24.6.19, and it is now being prepared for introduction to its iOS application. In addition to the status mentions feature, WhatsApp is also working on a new locking function. This upcoming feature will enable users to lock conversations on companion smartphones, along with creating private mentions while sharing stories. These features are currently available in the WhatsApp beta version 2.24.8.4, providing users with enhanced security measures for their conversations across all linked devices.

author: Liam Doolan
title: Dragon Quest 12 Reportedly Suffers Delay, Producer Steps Down Following Reshuffle - Nintendo Life
mainText: Square Enix is currently undergoing a large-scale organisational overhaul and it seems Dragon Quest has been impacted. According to a new report from Bloomberg, Dragon Quest's top producer Yu Miyake, who is now 56 years of age and has contributed to numerous Dragon Quest titles over the years, will be stepping down from the role following delays of the new entry. He will supposedly head up Square Enix's Tokyo-based smart game division from here on out. Miyake originally joined the Japanese publisher and developer back in 1992. As for his replacement, it's believed 53-year-old NieR producer Yosuke Saito will take over his position. Saito is apparently a strong candidate for the role according to Bloomberg's sources and also previously worked as a producer on Dragon Quest XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age. As part of this restructure, Takashi Kiryu is now at the helm as company president. No release date or platforms have been announced for Dragon Quest XII: The Flames of Fate but if there are any significant developments, we'll let you know.

author: Peter
title: Weekly poll: did you buy a OnePlus Nord CE4? Are you planning to? - GSMArena.com news - GSMArena.com
mainText: The OnePlus Nord CE4, a new entrant in the smartphone market, has been launched in India this week. The question arises - have you purchased one or are you contemplating it? For a detailed understanding of the phone, you can refer to our hands-on review of the Nord CE4. The phone is powered by the new Snapdragon 7 Gen 3, which provides a significant increase in GPU performance (almost double) and a comparable CPU speed to its predecessor. The Qualcomm chip is coupled with 8GB of RAM and 128/256GB storage (UFS 3.1), and there's a microSD slot for additional storage. The camera employs a new main sensor (Sony LYT-600), which delivers good quality images at 12.5MP resolution. However, the high-resolution 50MP mode and the 2x zoom could be improved. The battery capacity has been increased by 10% to 5,500mAh and it supports faster charging at 100W (wired only). In our tests, the phone was fully charged in 29 minutes, and a 15-minute charge was sufficient to reach 69%. The OnePlus Nord CE4 is priced at ₹25,000 for the 8/128GB model and ₹27,000 for the 8/256GB variant. Starting from April 5, you can avail an instant bank discount of up to ₹1,500 and an exchange bonus of up to ₹2,500.

author: India Today Auto Desk
title: Forget Hyundai Verna or Honda City, this is the only sedan driving the segment - India Today
mainText: The Indian car market had its best year ever in FY24, with volumes exceeding 40,00,000 units for the first time, reaching 42,29,566 units. However, the sedan segment saw a decline, dropping to 9%. Despite this, one sedan has consistently performed well, and it's not the Hyundai Verna or Honda City, but the Maruti Suzuki Dzire. While the overall market share of the sedan segment declined in FY24, the Maruti Suzuki Dzire managed to improve its performance by more than 9% year-on-year (y-o-y), selling 1.64 lakh units, up from 1.50 lakh units in FY23. The Maruti Suzuki Dzire is the top-selling sedan in India by a significant margin, regularly appearing among the best-selling cars in the country. The Dzire is known for its smooth engine, fuel efficiency, and spacious cabin. The Maruti Suzuki Dzire is currently priced between Rs 6.56 lakh and Rs 9.39 lakh (ex-showroom). It comes with features like LED projector headlamps with DRLs, LED rear combination lamps, auto-foldable ORVMs, precision cut dual-tone alloy wheels, multifunction steering wheel, colored TFT MID, Smartplay Studio touch infotainment system, automatic climate control, and cruise control. The Dzire is powered by a 1.2-litre K-Series Dual-Jet Dual-VVT petrol engine, which produces 88bhp of maximum power and 113Nm of peak torque. There is also a CNG version available. The transmission options include a 5-speed MT and 5-speed AMT for the petrol version and a 5-speed MT for the CNG version. The car is very fuel-efficient, with a claimed mileage of 22.41kmpl for the petrol MT, 22.61kmpl for the petrol AMT, and 31.12kmpkg for the CNG MT. Maruti Suzuki India is currently working on a new version of the Dzire, which is expected to be launched in the country in the September quarter of FY25. The new model has been spotted during testing, revealing some new features like new LED headlamps and taillamps, redesigned alloy wheels, a 360-degree camera, and an electric sunroof.

author: Boudhaditya Sanyal
title: Google TV combines smart features and quality viewing: Top 7 models for your home entertainment | Mint - Mint
mainText: Google TVs are more than just entertainment. They bring together high resolution viewing along with multiple smart features to have a better viewing experience. Check out the top 7 choices to upgrade your viewing patterns and bring home the one that suits your leisure time the best. Access multiple OTT and streaming platforms with a smooth OS on Google TVs. This MI 32-inch HD Ready Smart Google TV stands as a proof to how compact screens can still deliver an impressive entertainment experience. Its HD Ready resolution, backed by HDR 10 and a vivid picture engine, ensures a stunning visual experience. The Google Assistant and Chromecast built-in further enhance the smart features, while the 20W speakers with DTS Virtual:X technology deliver immersive audio. The TV also supports multiple connectivity options, including HDMI, USB, and Wi-Fi.

author: Adan Khan
title: Government issues high risk hacking alert for Android and iPhone users: What you can do - News9 LIVE
mainText: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has issued a high-severity warning for Android and iPhone users. The warning is in response to a significant vulnerability affecting the latest Android and iPhone users, which poses a substantial risk of data theft by potential hackers. If your smartphone’s software is not updated, whether it’s an iPhone or an Android device, it becomes vulnerable to hacking. CERT-In has issued a warning regarding this issue for both operating systems. Devices including iPhones, iPads, Macs and Pro Vision headsets are at risk. Hackers may target models older than the iPhone 8. Apple has rolled out software updates for its devices, urging users to promptly update their mobile systems. Additionally, CERT has issued a warning advising Android 12 users to upgrade to Android 14 due to security concerns. Samsung has initiated the release of security patches for its mobile phones, while other Android manufacturers are slated to release their updates in April. Failing to update your mobile operating system could leave it vulnerable to hacking attempts. Ensure to regularly check for system updates and keep your device updated at all times to safeguard against potential threats. Android versions affected include Android 12, Android 12L, Android 13, and Android 14. Apple software and devices affected include Apple Safari versions prior to 17.4.1, Apple macOS Ventura versions prior to 13.6.6, Apple macOS Sonoma versions prior to 14.4.1, Apple visionOS versions prior to 1.1.1, Apple iOS and iPadOS versions prior to 17.4.1, and Apple iOS and iPadOS versions prior to 16.7.7.

author: Moneycontrol News
title: Jefferies raises target prices on Tata Steel, JSW Steel, Hindalco as global factory activity picks up - Moneycontrol
mainText: Jefferies, a global investment banking firm, has increased its target prices on Tata Steel, JSW Steel, and Hindalco. This move comes in light of the recent resurgence in global manufacturing activity, particularly in the United States and China, the world's two largest economies. Jefferies has expressed a bullish outlook on Indian metal companies and has a constructive view on the sector, especially copper and aluminium. The Nifty metal index saw a surge of over a percent on April 9, closing at 8,894.4, leading the sectoral indices. Jefferies has maintained a 'buy' rating on Tata Steel and Hindalco Industries stocks, but has increased their target prices. The target price for Tata Steel has been raised to Rs 200 from Rs 165, indicating a 20 percent upside from the closing price on April 9. Similarly, the target price for Hindalco has been increased to Rs 700 from Rs 610, nearly 20 percent higher than the closing price on April 9. Although Jefferies has retained a 'hold' call on JSW Steel, it has increased the target price to Rs 900 from Rs 800, implying a 3 percent upside from the closing price on April 9. The positive sentiment in metal stocks is attributed to the significant increase in manufacturing activities reported by China and the US. As these two countries are major consumers of metal, an increase in manufacturing activity would lead to increased demand for metal. The US manufacturing sector has seen growth for the first time in 18 months, according to the Institute for Supply Management (ISM). Its US manufacturing PMI rose to 50.3 in March from 47.8 in February, marking its highest reading since September 2022. In a similar vein, China's manufacturing activity expanded in March for the first time since September, indicating stabilisation for the world's second-largest economy. China's PMI rose to 50.8 in March from 49.1 in February, surpassing the forecast of 49.9 in a poll. Despite challenges in the property sector, this data provides some relief to policymakers and boosts confidence in the economy.

author: Moneycontrol News
title: Paytm may slip after payments bank chief quits, BofA resumes coverage with 'underperform' rating - Moneycontrol
mainText: Paytm's shares might experience a dip on April 10 following the resignation of Surinder Chawla, the Managing Director and Chief Executive of Paytm Payments Bank. Chawla cited personal reasons and the pursuit of better career opportunities as the reasons for his departure, which will be effective from June 26, as stated in a regulatory filing by the company. Paytm's parent company, One 97 Communications, confirmed in a press release that 'nearly all agreements' between the company and Paytm Payments Bank have been terminated. The board of Paytm Payments Bank has been restructured with five independent directors, including an independent chairperson, and no nominees from the company. Founder Vijay Shekhar Sharma resigned from the board of the embattled Paytm Payments Bank on February 26 to facilitate the reconstitution of the board. The troubles for Paytm began on January 31 when the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) imposed significant business restrictions on Paytm Payments Bank, including a prohibition on accepting fresh deposits and conducting credit transactions after February 29. On February 16, the deadline was extended to March 15. Just a day before the RBI's ban could take effect, the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) approved Paytm's request to participate in UPI services as a third-party application provider (TPAP) under the multi-bank model. Despite these developments, Paytm's market share in the unified payments interface (UPI) dropped to 9 percent in March, its lowest level in the last four years, according to data available on the NPCI website. In February, it had dropped to 11 percent from the previous month following the RBI's severe restrictions on Paytm Payments Bank. Bank of America (BofA) has resumed its coverage on the stock with an 'underperform' rating and a target price of Rs 400, which represents a 1 percent downside from the closing price of Rs 404.50 on the NSE on April 9. The brokerage anticipates a gradual growth in Paytm's lending business.

author: Sunil Shankar Matkar
title: Daily Voice: Vikas Khemani bullish on FY25. Here are his 2 must-haves - Moneycontrol
mainText: Vikas Khemani, the founder of Carnelian Asset Management & Advisors, is optimistic about the market prospects for FY25. He believes that earnings growth is broad-based and stable, and there are no macroeconomic headwinds. Khemani anticipates a significant influx of funds into India following the elections, which he believes will further stimulate the market. With over 27 years of experience in capital markets, Khemani continues to be overweight on technology stocks. He identifies engineering research and development as a major theme within the IT sector. He does not foresee any panic or macroeconomic headwind that could disrupt the market. He expects a lot of flows to come to India post-elections, which can further drive the market from here. He believes that the momentum for India will continue this year as well. Fundamentally, he sees India as being well-positioned in terms of growth and return on equity (ROE) compared to other emerging countries. He also sees valuation as an interplay of four factors — ROE, growth, interest rates, and risk premium. In each of these factors, he believes India is better placed than at any time in the past and better than any other markets. He acknowledges that there are pockets of euphoria in the market that one should avoid, but he does not see the markets as a whole as being overvalued. He continues to be overweight in technology stocks, seeing IT as the best sector to play the US interest rate cycle. He sees FY24 as forming the bottom of growth for the sector, with revenue revival expected in FY25. He believes that the Federal Reserve will start cutting rates in the later part of CY24. He has also bought power stocks, as he sees a lot of investment happening in this space. He sees this as a global trend and believes that a lot of power ancillaries will also do well. He continues to remain positive on the sector. Auto has seen growth after a long period of time and is also a good play on consumer demand.

author: Investor's Business Daily
title: Dow Jones Futures: Stock Market Awaits CPI Inflation, Nvidia Chipmaker; Tesla Rises Again - Investor's Business Daily
mainText: Dow Jones futures, along with S&P 500 futures and Nasdaq 100 futures, were slightly higher in the early hours of Wednesday. The market is eagerly awaiting the release of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation report. In the meantime, Nvidia, a leading chipmaker, reported strong Q1 sales due to increased demand for AI. However, the company's shares fell as Google's parent company, Alphabet, announced a new in-house AI processor using Arm Holdings' designs, reducing its dependence on Nvidia chips. Intel also unveiled an AI chip to compete with Nvidia. Despite these developments, Google's stock rose further into a buy zone, while Intel's stock edged up after setting fresh lows for 2024. Tesla's shares extended their gains as Elon Musk touted the company's robotaxis. Tesla's shares edged higher early Wednesday, even as two more analysts slashed their estimates. The stock market rally generally edged higher on Tuesday, with investors being cautious of making big moves ahead of the CPI inflation report. Breadth was positive, but a number of leaders came under pressure. Nvidia's stock undercut recent lows on Tuesday but found key support. The positive sentiment in the stock market today is attributed to the significant increase in manufacturing activities reported by China and the US. As these two countries are major consumers of metal, an increase in manufacturing activity would lead to increased demand for metal. The US manufacturing sector has seen growth for the first time in 18 months, according to the Institute for Supply Management (ISM). Its US manufacturing PMI rose to 50.3 in March from 47.8 in February, marking its highest reading since September 2022. Similarly, China's manufacturing activity expanded in March for the first time since September, indicating stabilisation for the world's second-largest economy. China's PMI rose to 50.8 in March from 49.1 in February, surpassing the forecast of 49.9 in a poll. Despite challenges in the property sector, this data provides some relief to policymakers and boosts confidence in the economy.

author: Livemint
title: Indian stock market: 7 key things that changed for market overnight - Gift Nifty, US Treasury yields to oil prices | Mint - Mint
mainText: The Indian stock market saw several key changes overnight. The Gift Nifty was trading around the 22,813 level, a premium of nearly 80 points from the Nifty futures’ previous close, indicating a gap-up start for the Indian stock market indices. Asian markets traded mostly lower while the US stocks ended mixed overnight ahead of the key inflation data. The Sensex fell 58.80 points, or 0.08%, to close at 74,683.70, while the Nifty 50 index settled 23.55 points, or 0.1%, lower at 22,642.75. The market is expecting the uptrend to continue amid healthy Q4.

author: HT Auto Desk
title: Indian auto industry poised to grow amidst mix of optimism and challenge: FADA - HT Auto
mainText:
The Indian auto industry is poised for growth despite facing a mix of optimism and challenges, according to the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA). The industry has been resilient and adaptable, navigating through the pandemic and supply chain disruptions. However, it continues to grapple with issues such as semiconductor shortages, rising input costs, and changing consumer preferences.

FADA’s President, Vinkesh Gulati, highlighted that the auto sector has shown remarkable resilience and adaptability. The industry has embraced digitalization, e-commerce, and new business models to stay competitive. Additionally, the shift towards electric vehicles (EVs) and sustainable practices is gaining momentum.

While the industry remains optimistic about growth prospects, it also faces challenges. The semiconductor shortage has impacted production schedules, leading to delays in vehicle deliveries. Rising input costs, including raw materials and logistics, are putting pressure on margins. Furthermore, consumer preferences are evolving, with demand for connected features, safety technologies, and cleaner mobility options.

Despite these challenges, FADA believes that the Indian auto industry’s growth trajectory remains positive. The sector’s ability to adapt, innovate, and collaborate will be crucial in overcoming obstacles and achieving sustainable growth.

author: Quentyn Kennemer
title: Cruise will resume robotaxi tests after one of its cars ran someone over - The Verge
mainText: Cruise, the autonomous driving subsidiary of General Motors, is preparing to resume its robotaxi operations in the United States. This comes after a pause in operations that was initiated in November 2023, following an incident where a pedestrian was trapped underneath a Cruise AV after they were struck by a human-driven vehicle. The company is now working with officials in Texas for a potential relaunch. Houston and Dallas, Texas are emerging as potential locations for Cruise to restart its self-driving operations. However, the final spot has yet to be officially confirmed. The company's spokesperson, Pat Morrissey, stated that their goal is to relaunch in one city with manually driven vehicles and supervised testing as soon as possible once they have taken steps to rebuild trust with regulators and the public. Despite the plans to resume operations, it is acknowledged that it will likely take at least four to five years to restore public trust in its robotaxi units.

author: ETMarkets.com
title: Stocks in news: Axis Bank, Paytm, ABFRL, ICICI Pru Life, Shivalik Rasayan - The Economic Times
mainText: In the latest stock market news, shares of Axis Bank, Paytm, ABFRL, ICICI Pru Life, and Shivalik Rasayan are in the spotlight. Axis Bank has seen a significant exit by private equity major Bain Capital, which sold its remaining 1% stake in the lender through the open market for Rs 3,574 crore. Amidst controversy over misleading advertisements by Patanjali, Baba Ramdev and Acharya Balkrishna have submitted affidavits to the Supreme Court, offering 'unconditional, unqualified' apologies. Paytm Payments Bank's managing director and chief executive officer, Surinder Chawla, has resigned from the company, as announced by One 97 Communications, an associate entity of the bank and holding company of Paytm. ICICI Pru Life Insurance has received a demand order from the GST department for Rs 20.5 crore for the financial year 2018-19. ABFRL has incorporated a new subsidiary, Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands, for the proposed demerger of Madura Fashion and lifestyle business of the company. Lastly, the US FDA has completed the inspection of Shivalik Rasayan's Dahej-based API facility and issued 7 observations.

author: Michaela Zee
title: Jessica Alba Steps Down as The Honest Company’s Chief Creative Officer - Variety
mainText: Jessica Alba, the co-founder of The Honest Company, has announced her decision to step down from her role as the Chief Creative Officer. This news was shared by Alba herself on Instagram. She expressed that while there would never have been an easy time to make this decision, she is confident in the leadership team in place, with CEO Carla Vernón leading the charge to further the company's founding vision and strengthen its legacy as an industry innovator. The Honest Company stated that Alba would now 'shift her creative energy to new endeavors', while continuing to provide her support and leadership on the board of directors. Alba expressed her gratitude for the journey with The Honest Company, from pitching the first concept book to her friends in a Mommy and Me class, to ringing the Nasdaq bell with her family by her side. She thanked the entire Honest team for their unwavering commitment to the company's mission and for allowing her to be the best version of herself. She also expressed her gratitude to the Honest families and encouraged them to continue sharing their stories and testimonials. Alba concluded her statement by thanking the community for showing her that a girl with an unconventional path in business could help lead a movement for good.

author: Hormaz Fatakia
title: Paytm Share Price: Domestic, foreign funds raise stake even as stock falls 37% in March quarter - CNBCTV18
mainText: India's mutual funds now own a 6.15% stake in One97 Communications Ltd., parent company of payments aggregator Paytm, as per the company's latest shareholding pattern on BSE. They owned a 4.99% stake at the end of the December quarter, which back then, was the highest in the company's history. The increase comes despite the shares of Paytm falling as much as 50% during the January-March period to an all-time low of ₹318 before staging a minor recovery. Yet, the stock saw losses of 37% at the end of the March quarter. Interestingly, while the mutual fund shareholding in Paytm increased, the number of funds that held stake declined. Currently, 18 funds hold stake in Paytm, compared to the 23 funds that had holdings at the end of December last year. Nippon Mutual Funds and Mirae Mutual Funds, both existing shareholders of Paytm, have increased their stake during the March quarter. Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) have also increased their holdings in Paytm during the March quarter. As per the BSE categorisation, 'Foreign Portfolio Investors Category I,' which held a 17.69% stake in the company in December, now own 20.19% stake. Some funds whose names appeared in the recent shareholding data and have a stake in excess of 1% include Tiger Pacific Master Fund, Goldman Sachs, Government Pension Fund Global among others. However, when one looks at the cumulative Foreign Institutional Ownership, that figure has come down from 63.72% in December to 60.4% in March. That is because, SVF India Holdings, a SoftBank entity pared stake in the company during the quarter via block deals. From a 6.46% stake in the December quarter, SVF India Holdings (Cayman) Ltd. is now left with a 1.4% stake. Paytm's shares took a beating during the March quarter after the Reserve Bank of India barred Paytm Payments Bank from undertaking any banking activities ranging from deposits, to credit transactions to top ups from February 29, a date that was later extended to March 15.

author: Anthony Robledo
title: Costco's gold bars rake in up to $200 million a month: Experts - USA TODAY
mainText: Costco, the retail giant, is making a fortune from its gold bars. According to a Wells Fargo equity research note, the company is earning between $100 million and $200 million a month by selling gold bars. In October last year, Costco started selling 1-ounce bars made of nearly pure 24-karat gold, priced at about $2,000. The report stated that the addition of gold and silver to Costco's offerings reinforces its value proposition. However, the pricing and shipping costs suggest that it's a low-profit business at best. The wholesaler priced its gold appropriately, selling about 2% above spot prices to members before a 2% cash back reward for executive members and an extra 2% in cash back for those with a Citi card. The metal was responsible for about $100 million in sales between its debut and the end of the fiscal quarter ending Nov. 26. Recently, Costco also started selling silver coins. The coins are sold in tubes of 25 and are nonrefundable. The 1-ounce Canada Maple Leaf Silver Coins were priced at about $680 before selling out online earlier this month. Also for sale are coins with a maple leaf on the front and a silhouette of King Charles III on the back, which may be available for less at your local warehouse. Costco members can buy a total of five tubes of coins. Also found on the site: a 2024 1-ounce Canada Maple Leaf 24-karat gold coin priced at $2,219.99. The success of Costco with the metal comes as spot prices for gold rose more than 13.70% since the start of 2024. The price of gold traded at $2,349.44 per troy ounce as of 9 a.m. ET Monday, a 0.87% increase since Sunday. The lowest trading price between the 24-hour period was $2,318.90 per ounce while the highest was $2,365.35 per ounce.

author: Andrea Vacchiano
title: McDonald's $25 'deal' goes viral; users blame California's minimum-wage increase: 'Your new normal' - Fox Business
mainText: A social media video about a $25 McDonald's 'deal' recently sparked an online debate about California's minimum-wage increase. The video was shared by a TikTok user @shannon_montipaya on March 27. She was at a Southern California McDonald's drive-thru when she saw a sign for a 40-piece Chicken McNugget meal deal, which also included two large orders of fries. The price of the meal bundle was $25.39 — including sales tax, it would come to roughly $27. The user lamented that the meal didn't even include a drink. The meal is designed to serve four people, and it demonstrates how prices at the fast-food chain have risen over the years. A recent study by FinanceBuzz found that McDonald's prices have increased by 100% since 2014. Ten years ago, the average price of a 10-piece McNugget meal was $5.99. Now, the meal usually goes for $10.99. The video ended up amassing 2 million views, bringing thousands of TikTok users to its comments section — many of whom were nostalgic about past McDonald's prices. Some social media users pointed to the recent legislation in California that increased the minimum wage for fast-food workers from $16 to $20. Other users shared their local McDonald's prices — and very few came close to being as high as California's.

author: Hamsini Karthik
title: Tesla in talks with Reliance to set up EV manufacturing arm in India - BusinessLine
mainText: Tesla, the US electric vehicles major, is reportedly in discussions with Reliance Industries for a potential joint venture to establish a manufacturing facility in India. The talks are in the preliminary stages and have been ongoing for over a month. It is important to note that this move does not signify RIL's entry into the automobile space. Rather, RIL's objective in the joint venture is to build capacities for electric vehicles in India. While the role of RIL hasn't been finalized yet, it is expected that the Indian conglomerate may play a significant role in establishing the manufacturing facility and the allied ecosystem for Tesla in India. In 2023, RIL, in partnership with Ashok Leyland, launched India’s first hydrogen internal combustion engine-powered heavy-duty truck. RIL also unveiled removable and swappable batteries for EVs last year. Tesla is said to have committed $2 billion to its upcoming plans in India. The company has been looking at multiple locations, including Gujarat and Maharashtra, for setting up the plant. Sources said that Maharashtra could emerge as the preferred location. Tesla plans to use the facility for domestic and export purposes, and hence, it may prefer a location suitable for port facilities. Senior officials of Tesla are expected to visit the country to finalize the plant location in a month or so and crystallize on the joint venture with RIL. Since the JV talks with RIL aren’t exclusive, Tesla may scout for another domestic partner if ongoing talks don’t fructify.

author: Axios
title: Boeing whistleblower alleges structural flaws in 787, 777 jets - Axios
mainText: A former Boeing engineer, Sam Salehpour, has raised allegations of structural flaws in Boeing's 787 Dreamliner and 777 jets. These flaws, according to Salehpour, could cause the aircraft to suddenly fail. The allegations, first published by the New York Times, have intensified the ongoing safety crisis at Boeing, which began with a mid-flight blowout with one of its 737 MAX 9 jets earlier this year. Following the blowout, federal regulators have pledged to increase scrutiny on Boeing's supply chain, manufacturing processes, and company culture. Salehpour had initially raised his concerns internally but was allegedly 'threatened and silenced by Boeing,' according to his lawyers. After facing intimidation from the company, Salehpour alerted the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), other government officials, and the public. His concerns relate to manufacturing flaws within the bodies of 787 and 777. Salehpour claimed that the fuselages, assembled from several pieces from multiple different manufacturers, were improperly fastened together and could suddenly break apart. His attorneys, Debra Katz and Lisa Banks, stated that 'Rather than heeding his warnings, Boeing prioritized getting the planes to market as quickly as possible, despite the known, well-substantiated issues he raised.' They added that the issues 'are the direct result of Boeing's decisions in recent years to prioritize profits over safety and a regulator in the FAA that has become too deferential to industry.' In response, Boeing stated that it is 'fully confident' in the 787 Dreamliner and dismissed the claims about the structural integrity of the jets as 'inaccurate.' The company added that the issues raised 'have been subject to rigorous engineering examination under FAA oversight.' 'This analysis has validated that these issues do not present any safety concerns and the aircraft will maintain its service life over several decades,' the company added. The FAA did not confirm if it was investigating Boeing over Salehpour's allegations, as reported by the Times, but stated that it investigates all reports it receives.

author: Todd Campbell
title: Veteran analyst delivers blunt warning about Nvidia's stock - TheStreet
mainText: An analyst with 50 years of experience weighs in on Nvidia shares. Nvidia’s opportunity to profit from exploding growth in artificial intelligence has already caught the eyes of investors. After surprising everybody with jaw-dropping revenue and earnings last summer, shares have catapulted higher on recognition of surging investment in AI research and development. Over the past year, Nvidia's stock price has increased by a remarkable 209%, including a 72% gain so far in 2024. The returns are arguably justified by the company's top and bottom-line growth; however, investors are right to wonder whether or not much of the upside from AI spending is already reflected in Nvidia's share price. That million-dollar question isn't lost on TheStreet Pro's Bruce Kamich. Kamich has analyzed stocks and major markets for over five decades to find winners. Recently, he updated his analysis of Nvidia, resulting in a blunt warning about what could happen to its stock. Jensen Huang, co-founder and chief executive officer of Nvidia Corp., believes AI is a "huge opportunity" for Nvidia. Nvidia's sales and profit soars on AI demand AI may seem like it's new, but the prospect of machines thinking independently has long been considered by scientists, futurists, authors, and movie makers. For instance, the mathematician and computer scientist Alan Turing researched how to design AI computers in the 1950s, and the lauded research firm Rand Corp created the first AI computer program in 1956. Science-fiction books and movies have contemplated the implications of AI many times. Isaac Asimov wrote "I, Robot" in 1950. Most of us have watched Arnold Schwarzenegger star in at least one of the Terminator movies, the first one released in 1984. Despite the concept being well-worn, mainstream use of AI tools only recently became widespread when OpenAI's ChatGPT became the fastest app to reach one million users following its launch in December 2022. ChatGPT was revolutionary in its ability to help anyone, anywhere, quickly search, parse, and create meaningful content from a simple search bar. The ability of large language AI models like ChatGPT to generate unique insights from previously siloed data sets has unlocked a torrent of activity across most industries. Financial institutions like JP Morgan use it to hedge risks and evaluate and price loans. Drugmakers are evaluating if it can create better medicines. Manufacturers are investigating if it can improve quality and production. Retailers are researching its potential to improve inventory levels and stop theft. The U.S. Department of Defense is contemplating how AI may reshape the battlefield. "While we do not know the full effect or the precise rate at which AI will change our business — or how it will affect society at large — we are completely convinced the consequences will be extraordinary and possibly as transformational as some of the major technological inventions of the past several hundred years: Think the printing press, the steam engine, electricity, computing, and the Internet, among others," said JP Morgan CEO Jamie Dimon in April.

author: Edward Segarra
title: Jay Leno granted conservatorship over estate of wife Mavis Leno amid dementia battle - USA TODAY
mainText: Jay Leno has been declared the conservator of his wife Mavis Leno’s estate amid her battle with dementia. Leno, who filed his petition for the conservatorship in Los Angeles court in January, had his request granted during a hearing on Tuesday. The court found that a conservatorship of the estate was necessary and appropriate as Mavis Leno was unable to care for her financial affairs and was subject to undue influence. Mavis consented to the ruling and did not object to the conservatorship of the estate. Judge Brenda J. Penny told Leno in court that everything he was doing was right and understood that this was a difficult period. Leno shared during the hearing that he was in the process of estate planning and reviewing Mavis’ will. Mavis' court-appointed attorney Ronald E. Ostrin had no comment when contacted by USA TODAY following the ruling. In January, Leno petitioned the L.A. court to become the conservator of his wife Mavis’ estate to ensure her estate plan is correctly executed because she presently lacks the necessary capacity. Mavis, 77, suffers from dementia, major neurocognitive disorder, her physician wrote in a doctor's capacity declaration, which also outlined the decline of her cognitive function. Unfortunately, Mavis has been progressively losing capacity and orientation to space and time for several years. Leno’s filing also stated his wish to manage Mavis' half of their shared property and her assets in a trust, which would provide for her, her brother and Leno. The couple does not have children, and she has no other siblings. More light was shed on the extent of Mavis’ battle with dementia when Ostrin shared additional information about her condition in court documents filed in California in March. According to her neurologist, Dr. Hart Cohen, Mavis Leno has advanced dementia and sometimes does not know her husband, Jay, nor her date of birth. She has a lot of disorientation, will ruminate about her parents who have both passed and her mother who died about 20 years ago.

mainText: The first trailer for 'Joker: Folie à Deux' has been released, featuring Joaquin Phoenix reprising his Oscar-winning role as Arthur Fleck, who later becomes Batman’s notorious foe, and Lady Gaga as the equally twisted Harley Quinn. Little is known about the actual plot of the sequel, which is reportedly a jukebox musical. In the trailer, they waltz across rooftops and through Gotham City to notes of 'What the World Needs Now Is Love.' 'I like to say it’s a movie where music is an essential element,' says Phillips. author: Christine Rousselle
title: Disney announces changes to disability access for guests at its theme parks - Fox Business
mainText: Disney has announced that it will be making significant changes to its Disability Access Service (DAS) at its theme parks in California and Florida. The announcement was made on Tuesday, April 9, 2024. The DAS, which is a free service, allows individuals with disabilities to receive a return time for attractions, eliminating the need to wait in a standard line. The changes to the DAS were announced on the Disneyland and Walt Disney World websites. The websites now state that the DAS is intended to accommodate a small percentage of guests who, due to a developmental disability like autism or similar, are unable to wait in a conventional queue for an extended period of time. This is a change from the previous indication that the DAS was for guests who have difficulty tolerating extended waits in a conventional queue environment due to a disability. The new changes will take effect on May 20 at Walt Disney World in Florida and June 18 at Disneyland in California. Until then, the existing DAS procedure will continue. In addition to the changes in eligibility for the DAS, Disney has also changed the procedure for requesting the service. Starting May 20, 2024, all DAS registrations at Walt Disney World must be done via virtual video chat, and in-person registration will no longer be available at theme park Guest Relations locations. At Disneyland, after June 18, guests applying for DAS can either use a virtual chat or a dedicated 'accessibility services' window for same-day requests. Once DAS is granted, it will be valid for either the length of the guest's theme park ticket, or for up to 120 days. It will be possible to re-register for DAS once these dates have passed, according to Disney. Previously, DAS was valid for a 60-day period.

author: Rapid Recap Team
title: 3 shot after celebration to mark end of Ramadan in the Parkside section of Philadelphia - WPVI-TV
mainText: Three people were shot and five people are in custody after gunfire erupted in a Philadelphia park where an event to mark the end of the Muslim holy month of Ramadan was taking place. The shooting happened around 2:30 p.m. Wednesday in the area of 47th and Girard in the Parkside section as an estimated 1,000 people were at an Eid al-Fitr celebration. Philadelphia Police Commissioner Kevin Bethel said two factions inside the park exchanged gunfire, and some 30 gunshots were fired. Officers who were on detail in the area managed to stop three males and a female, all of whom were taken into custody. Four guns were recovered at that time, Bethel said. Meanwhile, one of the police officers engaged an armed 15-year-old male, shooting that teen in the shoulder and leg. The officer secured the gun and then took the teen to the hospital, Bethel said. That 15-year-old is also under arrest. A 22-year-old man suffered a gunshot wound to the stomach, while a juvenile arrived at the hospital with a gunshot wound to his hands. Amid the chaos, Bethel said a police vehicle struck a child and she suffered a fractured leg. Bethel said the department is sending prayers to her and will be reaching out to her family. Video from Chopper 6 showed multiple tables, chairs and tents that were abandoned in the chaos. "I just saw everybody just running and frantic, you know, everybody. The kids, people's strollers getting turned over, everybody screaming," said one witness who did not want to be identified. "I heard fireworks... and it sort of turned into gunshots." "Everybody just ran away like it was an elephant stampede," she continued. Police officers could be seen conducting a meticulous search for shell casings and evidence of gunfire. Citywide police response called Officers from across the city of Philadelphia were called in to assist in this incident. Various law enforcement units, including SWAT, rapidly converged on the scene. Eyewitness accounts and police activity suggest the shooting led to widespread panic, with attendees fleeing for safety. The presence of multiple crime scenes and the discovery of several firearms point to a complex investigation.

author: Katcy Stephan
title: Ice Spice Set to Appear in Spike Lee’s ‘High and Low’ With Denzel Washington (EXCLUSIVE) - Variety
