These attacks, referred to as 'mercenary attacks', do not target users for personal information like bank account numbers. Instead, they target high-profile individuals such as politicians, journalists, and diplomats because of their status or profession. Apple describes these mercenary spyware attacks as some of the most advanced digital threats currently in existence. Despite the complexity of these attacks, Apple urges users to take their warnings seriously. The company explains that these attacks are more complex than regular cybercriminal activity and consumer malware, and they are constantly evolving due to their unusual funding. Although the term 'state-sponsored' is not used in the latest warning, Apple states that these attacks have historically been associated with state actors. Since 2021, Apple has issued warnings to people in at least 150 countries about the possibility of their devices being targeted by 'exceptionally well-funded' attacks. If you receive a spyware warning on your iPhone, Apple recommends updating your iOS to the latest version as they have released numerous updates in recent years to fix security flaws that may have been exploited by spyware attacks.

mainText: NASA's solar sail, a unique device that was once only a concept in science fiction, is now ready to make its debut. This solar sail, known as the Advanced Composite Solar Sail System, will be launched from Mahia in New Zealand aboard Rocket Labs Electron rocket. The sail will rely solely on the Sun for propulsion, using the energy from photons bouncing off the reflective sail to move and gain momentum. This eliminates the need for expensive propulsion systems, significantly reducing the cost of missions. The solar sail will also test a composite boom made of flexible polymer and carbon fiber material. Once launched into space and at an altitude of about 1000 km above Earth, the spacecraft will start stretching out its composite booms. When fully deployed, it will measure 80 square meters. Interestingly, the spacecraft may even be visible from Earth under the right lighting conditions.

author: Victoria Kennedy
title: Fallout 4 free next-gen update finally arrives this month - Eurogamer.net
mainText: Fallout 4, the popular post-apocalyptic role-playing game, is finally getting its long-awaited next-gen update. This update will bring the game up to a smooth 60fps with increased resolutions on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. The update, which is free, includes native applications for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, Performance mode and Quality mode settings, as well as stability improvements and fixes. Players on PS4 and Xbox One will also see improved stability and fixes for login and quest issues. For PC players, the update brings additional features such as widescreen and ultra-widescreen support, fixes to Creation Kit, and a variety of quest updates. There will also be a number of bug fixes. The game will soon be available on the Epic Game Store, as well as being Steam Deck verified. The next-gen update for Fallout 4 is set to arrive on 25th April. In addition to the update, Bethesda has also promised more Fallout 4 content, including the Enclave Remnants, Makeshift Weapon Pack, and the Halloween Workshop.

author: Harvey Randall
title: I had a peek at Remnant 2's newly-announced second DLC: The Forgotten Kingdom, which fleshes out the forests of Yaesha with gorgeous vistas and machine gun pottery - PC Gamer
mainText: Harvey Randall, in his article titled 'I had a peek at Remnant 2's newly-announced second DLC: The Forgotten Kingdom, which fleshes out the forests of Yaesha with gorgeous vistas and machine gun pottery', provides an overview of the second DLC for Remnant 2. The DLC, named 'The Forgotten Kingdom', expands the forests of Yaesha, adding beautiful landscapes and machine gun pottery. The game Remnant 2, a third-person shooter action role-playing game, is the sequel to Remnant: From the Ashes. It was released in July 2023 for PlayStation 5, Windows PC and Xbox Series X/S. The game continues the story of the survivors and their fight against the Root, a race of evil plant species that seeks to destroy the multiverse. The DLC is expected to enhance the gaming experience by introducing new elements and expanding the game world.

author: Chris Welch
title: Sony's new headphones and speakers are all about skull-rattling bass - The Verge
mainText: Sony's upcoming WH-ULT900N headphones are already making noise, thanks to a leak from industry insider Roland Quandt. As a direct successor to the WH-XB910N, these headphones aim to redefine the mid-range audio market. The ‘ULT’ stands for the new “Ultimate Power Sound” technology that promises a premium experience at a fraction of the cost of Sony’s high-end models. With the new “Ultimate Power Sound” technology, the WH-ULT900N are said to offer a better listening experience together with the 40mm drivers with neodymium magnets. This technology lets users adjust the sound in two stages. This allows them to change the audio output to the listener’s taste, whether they want deep bass or very clear highs. According to the leak, the “Ultimate Power Sound” technology also widens the frequency range from 5 Hz to 20 kHz. This puts the WH-ULT900N close to Sony’s top WH-1000XM5, which offer bass that beats many competitors. Plus, they support a clear bass boost for an even deeper, pulsing rhythms. The Active Noise Cancelling (ANC) technology also makes the experience even more immersive, giving a space for sound in any location. The WH-ULT900N are also said to be a dependable partner for long listening sessions. These headphones have a strong 520mAh battery that gives up to 50 hours of playback without ANC, and up to 30 hours with both ANC and Bluetooth on. Bluetooth 5.2 connectivity improves the user experience with features like multi-pairing, allowing easy switching between audio sources. Also, support for AAC, LDAC, and SBC codecs ensures high-resolution audio. So, every note is heard clearly without any disruptions. Quandt’s leak also gives the first look into the design of the WH-ULT900N. According to this, the new headphones look like the high-end WH-1000XM4, but with some changes, giving a fresh look that is both known and new. The external USB-C ports have been replaced with what looks like a speaker grill. And, the Sony logo has been moved, setting the WH-ULT900N apart from their predecessors. The WH-ULT900N also works with Google Fast Pair for quick connectivity. Voice control through Google Assistant, Siri, or Amazon Alexa makes them easy to use, allowing hands-free operation for many functions.

author: Levi Winslow
title: Diablo IV's Next Season Will Completely Change How Loot Works - Kotaku
mainText: Diablo IV's upcoming season, Season 4, is set to bring about a significant shift in the game's loot system. The new season, which is scheduled to launch on May 14th, 2024, will focus on quality loot with fewer but more potent affixes. This change is expected to completely transform the way players interact with loot in the game. In addition to the changes in the loot system, Season 4 will also introduce the 'Vessel of Hatred' expansion pack. This expansion pack is set to release later this year and has been the subject of much anticipation and speculation among the Diablo IV community. The 'Vessel of Hatred' expansion pack will introduce a new class, the Spiritborn, along with new skills for all classes. The Spiritborn class is said to be tied to nature and will use Vigor as a resource. The expansion pack will also introduce new features such as Mercenaries and the Masterworking system, which allows for further item upgrades. The Pit of Artificers, a new feature introduced in the expansion pack, will provide new crafting materials and challenges, promising exceptional armor crafting opportunities. All these changes and additions are expected to significantly enhance the gameplay experience in Diablo IV.

author: Wesley Yin-Poole
title: Fallout 4’s Long-Awaited Next-Gen Update Finally Has a Release Date - IGN
mainText: The much-anticipated next-gen update for Fallout 4 has finally been given a release date. Bethesda has announced that the update will be available on April 25, 2024. This update will be free and will be available for Xbox Series X and S and PlayStation 5. The update includes native applications for the consoles, Performance mode and Quality mode settings, as well as stability improvements and fixes. This means the game will be playable up to 60 frames per second and with an increased resolution. In addition to the next-gen update, Fallout 4 on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One will also receive a free update with stability improvements, login and quest fixes. A free Fallout 4 update for PC will add widescreen and ultra-widescreen support, as well as fixes to Creation Kit and a variety of quest updates. Players with PC versions of Fallout 4 on Steam, Microsoft Store and GOG will receive stability, mods, and bug fixes. Fallout 4 will also be sold on the Epic Games Store, and will be Steam Deck verified. Bethesda has also announced more content in the Fallout 4 updates, including the following free Creation Club items: Enclave Remnants, Enclave Weapon Skins, Enclave Armor Skins, Tesla Cannon, Hellfire Power Armor, X-02 Power Armor, Heavy Incinerator, Makeshift Weapon Pack, and Halloween Workshop. Fallout 4, which was launched in 2015 across PC, PS4, and Xbox One, has generated $750 million in revenue. In the near decade since, Fallout 4 has continued to be one of the top-played games on Steam, with a huge number of mods keeping the experience fresh for players. The next-gen update is well-timed, given it arrives following the release of the Fallout TV show's first season.

author: Florence Ion
title: How to Use Android's Find My Device Network - Gizmodo
mainText: Android has introduced a new feature similar to Apple’s AirTags and Samsung's Galaxy Tag. This feature, known as the Find My Device (FMD) network, is now available in the US and Canada. It helps locate lost Android smartphones and tablets and will soon work with more headphones and earbuds. In May, Google will start support for smart tags from Pebblebee, Chipolo, Eufy, and JioTag. The FMD network locates devices through Bluetooth proximity, relying on other gadgets to relay the device's location. The location you see when you open the Find My Device mobile app comprises aggregated location information on the device you’re seeking and the other detectable ones around it. Google has addressed potential security concerns with Android’s Find My Device network. The company explains how FMD is end-to-end encrypted, ensuring that Google cannot identify the owners of the nearby Android devices that provided the location data. As an additional privacy safeguard, the app doesn’t collect data on surrounding Android devices. The Find My Device app won’t provide you with turn-by-turn directions to the object, but it can show a lost device’s proximity to the nearest Nest device in your smart home as a reference point. The Find My Device network is now available and is compatible with any device running Android 9 and above. You can download it from the Play Store if you don’t see the app populated in your launcher.

author: Rapid Recap Team
title: Android 15 adds a new screensaver that makes it easier to control your smart home - Android Authority
mainText: Android 15 is preparing to add a screensaver called “Home Controls” that lets you control your Google Home devices when your device is idle and charging. Android already lets you control your Google Home devices through the voice assistant, an app, a Quick Setting tile, and a lock screen shortcut, but this screensaver will be new. This screensaver isn’t currently available, but we managed to activate it to show it off. Although it has its fair share of problems, one benefit of investing in Google’s smart home ecosystem is how easy it is to control from your smartphone. You can invoke Google Assistant on any screen to quickly control your devices with your voice or you can open the Google Home app to change settings more precisely. Since Android 12, you’ve also been able to access your smart home control dashboard by tapping on a Quick Setting tile or lock screen shortcut. In the next release of Android, you may be able to access your Google Home devices from your screen saver. Android 15 may introduce a new screensaver called “Home Controls” that lets you “quickly access your home controls as a screensaver.” Although this screensaver isn’t currently visible in the latest Android 15 Developer Preview 2 or Android 14 QPR3 Beta 2.1 releases, I managed to activate it manually. Once live, the Home Controls screen saver will appear alongside other screensavers under Settings > Display > Screen saver. Here’s what the Home Controls screensaver looks like on a phone versus a tablet: As you can see, this screensaver simply shows the Google Home controls that you have favorited and the current time. The UI is even the same as the one that appears in Android 14 when you set the Google Home app as Android’s Device Controls provider and you open the smart home controls dashboard via the aforementioned Quick Setting tile or lock screen shortcut. Interestingly, Android 15’s Home Controls screensaver is actually provided by the SystemUI app and not by the Google Home app. Unfortunately, it only seems to work with Google Home and not other Device Controls providers, so other smart home apps will need to create their own screensavers. The upside is that this screensaver might be coming to non-Pixel devices in Android 15, since the code that implements it is under the com.android.systemui path instead of com.google.android.systemui, which means it should be included in the SystemUI app of AOSP in the near future. Would you be interested in using the Home Controls screensaver in Android 15? Let us know down below!

author: Kyle Barr
title: Here's What Reviewers Are Saying About the Humane Pin - Gizmodo
mainText: The Humane AI Pin, a wearable device that was touted as a means to liberate us from our phone dependency, has been met with disappointing reviews. Despite its robust build, the software falls short of its initial promises. The device, which costs $699 plus a $24 monthly subscription, is slow, lacks features, and at times, fails to function. The Humane AI Pin operates on its own OS, Cosmos, with some AI processes occurring on-device and others in the cloud. However, the device is largely hands-off. Users tap and hold the button to interact with it, making it similar to Star Trek communicators. The pin is designed to perform tasks such as making calls, sending texts, taking photos, and playing music with a Tidal subscription without the need for scrolling through or managing apps. It also has a small projection that can display images in your hand. Despite these features, the device often fails to respond when activated. Reviewers have reported that the device is slow to respond, frequently provides incorrect information, and lacks features that would be expected in a device like the AI Pin, such as email. The device also refuses to answer questions like 'Is this bag of chips good for me?' even with its vision technology installed. It is also reported to be incredibly buggy and seemingly incomplete. In its current state, the Humane AI Pin is not recommended for purchase.

author: Ben Schoon
title: Samsung confirms Galaxy AI is coming to more devices 'soon' - 9to5Google
mainText: Samsung has confirmed that its suite of Galaxy AI features, currently available on the Galaxy S24 series and 2023 Galaxy releases such as the Fold 5 and Flip 5, will be coming to more devices soon. This confirmation came during the announcement of the expansion of language support for its new AI features. There have been rumors of Samsung expanding support to even older devices, such as the Galaxy S22 series. In a recent press release regarding additional language support, Samsung directly confirmed its intention to bring Galaxy AI to more devices in due course. The company listed the currently supported devices and ended with a teaser for 'more coming soon', referring to other Galaxy devices that don't already have Galaxy AI. Samsung stated that the newly supported Galaxy AI languages and dialects will each be available for download as a language pack from the Settings app across all devices that support Galaxy AI. This includes the Galaxy S24 series, Galaxy S23 series, Galaxy S23 FE, Galaxy Z Flip5, and Galaxy Tab S9 series, with more coming soon. The next devices in line remain to be seen, but the Galaxy S22 series, Galaxy Z Fold 4, and Galaxy Z Flip 4 seem like obvious candidates.

author: Thomas Hundal
title: The Corvette ZR1 Is Coming And It Could Be The First Factory Twin-Turbo ’Vette - The Autopian
mainText: Chevrolet has officially announced that a new Corvette ZR1 will debut this summer. This news comes after more than a year since the last Corvette variant was announced. The new Corvette ZR1 is rumored to be powered by a twin-turbocharged V8 engine, which could potentially unsettle competitors in Stuttgart and Maranello. The ZR1 has a rich history, with the original model being a C3 Corvette with a high-performance small block and various performance enhancements. However, only 53 of these were made due to the lack of power steering, power windows, and a radio. The ZR1 name was revived in 1990 with the introduction of the C4 ZR-1, which was the first Corvette sold to the public with an overhead cam engine. This engine, developed by Lotus, started with 385 horsepower and increased to 405 horsepower in 1993. The C4 ZR-1 could accelerate from zero to 60 mph in less than five seconds and reach a top speed of 180 mph. The ZR1 name was brought back again in 2009 with the C6 ZR1, which boasted 638 horsepower and a top speed of 205 mph. The C6 ZR1 was only available with a manual transmission and was an instant hit. The ZR1 nameplate was continued in the C7 model for the 2019 model year, which pushed the limits of what a factory-produced front-engined Corvette could do. The upcoming Corvette ZR1 is expected to be powered by an engine called the LT7, which is suggested to be a 5.5-liter twin-turbocharged double overhead cam V8 according to a previous GM parts catalog leak. The engine could be either a cross-plane or flat-plane, but it is expected to have more than 670 horsepower. If the leak is accurate, the C8 ZR1 would be the first factory-produced turbocharged Corvette.

author: Vlad
title: OnePlus and Oppo devices will get Google's Gemini Ultra AI - GSMArena.com news - GSMArena.com
mainText: OnePlus and Oppo have announced that they will be integrating Google's Gemini Large Language Model (LLM), in its Ultra 1.0 iteration, into their phones later this year. This announcement was made at Google's Cloud Next 2024 conference. The Gemini LLM has several tiers, the smallest one being Nano, which can run on-device and is coming to the Pixel 8 soon. The Ultra version is the most capable cloud-based version of it, which powers the Gemini Advanced chatbot. Ultra understands highly complex tasks and context in order to deliver useful replies. In addition to Gemini, OnePlus and Oppo phones will also get select Google Cloud AI features, although it's unclear which ones. It's also unclear how 'Gemini Ultra is coming to OnePlus and Oppo phones' is different from using a browser to access Google's Gemini Advanced chatbot. More details are expected to be revealed in the coming weeks and months. Recently, OnePlus announced that its own version of Google's Magic Eraser would be coming to some of its phones. With this new announcement, it seems like Oppo and OnePlus are ready to fully embrace the AI hype.

author: https://www.india.com/author/intern37-seoindia-com/
title: Nubia Flip 5G Launched With Snapdragon 7 Gen 1, 120 Hz AMOLED Display, More; Check DEETS Here - India.com
mainText: Nubia has launched its first foldable smartphone, the Nubia Flip 5G, following its announcement at MWC 2024 earlier this year. The clamshell foldable phone is powered by a Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 chipset and features a 6.9-inch 120Hz AMOLED display. It aims to offer flagship-level foldable experience at a more affordable price point compared to devices like the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip series. The Nubia Flip 5g comes with a 6.9-inch FHD+ (2790 x 1188) foldable AMOLED main display with 120Hz refresh rate, 443 PPI, 100% DCI-P3 colour gamut, and 10-bit colour depth. It also has 1.43-inch OLED cover display for quick access to notifications and widgets. The Flip 5G smartphones is powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 chipset. The Nubia Flip 5G comes in two variants 8GB or 12GB RAM 256GB or 512GB storage. The device has a dual rear camera setup with 50MP main sensor and 2MP depth sensor. It also has a 16MP front-facing camera for selfies and video calling needs. The Nubia Flip 5G comes with a 4310mAh battery capacity. It supports 33W wired fast charging. The Nubia Flip 5G boasts of a slim design with 7.0mm thickness when unfolded. It also has a dual-rail suspended hinge rated for over 200,000 folds. Some additional features include- Side-mounted fingerprint sensor, Dual speakers with DTS:X Ultra processing and Snapdragon Sound technology, Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.2 connectivity, Runs on MyOS 13 based on Android 13. Nubia has not yet announced any plans to launch the Nubia Flip 5G in India. The phone is currently available for pre-order globally on Nubia’s official website, with open sales beginning from April 23, 2024.

author: Bill Toulas
title: Apple: Mercenary spyware attacks target iPhone users in 92 countries - BleepingComputer
mainText: Apple has been notifying iPhone users in 92 countries about a 'mercenary spyware attack' attempting to remotely compromise their device. In a sample notification the company shared with BleepingComputer, Apple says that it has high confidence in the warning and urges the recipient to take seriously. 'Apple detected that you are being targeted by a mercenary spyware attack that is trying to remotely compromise the iPhone associated with your Apple ID -xxx-,', reads the notification. This attack is likely targeting you specifically because of who you are or what you do. Although it’s never possible to achieve absolute certainty when detecting such attacks, Apple has high confidence in this warning — please take it seriously. To protect against such attacks, Apple recommends a set of immediate actions that include enabling lockdown mode on the device, updating the iPhone and any other Apple products to the latest software version, and seeking expert assistance such as that from the Digital Security Helpline - a non-profit that provides technical support at no cost for journalists, activists, and human rights defenders. When describing mercenary spyware attacks, the notification highlights NSO Group’s Pegasus kit and says that they are exceptionally well-funded, sophisticated, and target a very small number of individuals. Apple also updated its support page on spyware protection yesterday replacing the term 'state-sponsored' with 'mercenary spyware,' noting that these attacks are ongoing and global and sometimes involve private companies that develop spying tools for state actors. Primary targets of these attacks typically include journalists, activists, politicians, and diplomats due to their roles or the sensitive information they may possess. Despite the sophistication of these attacks, Apple assures users it’s doing everything in its power to detect them, alert users, and assist them in taking the necessary action. 'Mercenary spyware attacks cost millions of dollars and often have a short shelf life, making them much harder to detect and prevent,' reads the updated support page. 'Since 2021, we have sent Apple threat notifications multiple times a year as we have detected these attacks, and to date, we have notified users in over 150 countries in total,' Apple informs.

author: Anne-Marije Rook
title: 'A lot roadie, a little groadie': first ride impressions of the all-new Enve Fray, an endurance bike designed for and by former road racers - CyclingWeekly
mainText: Enve Composites has officially launched its first foldable bike, The Fray, which was initially planned for a 2023 release. The Fray is designed to fill the one remaining gap in the American manufacturer's drop bar line-up: an endurance bike. However, it's not just any endurance bike. The Fray is Enve's vision of 'the definitive all-road machine', designed for those who came from road racing and are now looking for broader two-wheeled objectives but performance is still critical. As Jake Pantone, Enve's VP of Product and Brand, put it: the Fray is 'a lot roadie, a little groadie' and aims to meet the demands of the modern road rider by pairing a road racing pedigree with all-road features like wider tire clearance, in-frame storage, and a fit comfortable for all-day adventures in the saddle. While classified as an 'all-road' or 'endurance' bicycle, Enve emphasizes that the Fray is by no means a slouch. 'The Fray is for riders who want speed, versatility, and max performance,' Pantone says. 'This is a [Personal Best] bike, not a sleepy comfort road bike. It's a performance bike in every way.' Enve is so confident in the performance aspect of the Fray that it offered the bike up for team TotalEnergies to ride at last week's Paris-Roubaix. But since the Melee clears35mm tires just fine, the riders opted to stick with their designated race bikes.

author: Divya Bhati
title: Apple to introduce new Safari browser assistant for iPhones with iOS 18 - India Today
mainText: Apple is set to introduce a dedicated Safari browsing assistant for iPhones with the upcoming iOS 18 update. This new feature was discovered in Apple's backend code by tipster Nicolás Álvarez. The Safari browsing assistant seems to use the Private Relay infrastructure to send data to Apple, ensuring that Apple doesn't know your IP. The specifics of how this feature will work are not yet available. This new assistant is part of Apple's ongoing efforts to introduce new generative AI features with iOS 18. These AI capabilities are already present in several other browsers, such as Microsoft Edge, which includes a Copilot feature powered by GPT-4 and Arc Search. In addition to the Safari browsing assistant, Álvarez also spotted a function named 'Encrypted Visual Search' in the code, but its specifics are still unclear. Apart from these AI enhancements, iOS 18 is expected to bring several significant updates, including AI integration across various iOS applications. For example, Apple Music might curate personalised playlists based on your listening habits, while stock apps like Mail and Notes could gain AI-powered features for improved functionality. Siri is also set for a substantial upgrade with the integration of large language models (LLMs), transforming it into a comprehensive 'ultimate virtual assistant' with improved conversational capabilities and deeper Shortcuts integration. iPhone users might finally be able to enjoy features like enhanced video quality and read receipts when messaging Android users through rumoured RCS support.

author: Sunil Shankar Matkar
title: IPO Market Action: 3 public issues to open for subscription with 2 listings scheduled next week - Moneycontrol
mainText: The mainboard segment of the primary market seems to be losing euphoria as there will be no new initial public offering hitting Dalal Street next week starting from April 15. However, there will be a big follow-on public offer (FPO) by Vodafone Idea. In the coming week, the SME segment will remain busy with two IPOs opening for subscription and two companies listing shares. Vodafone Idea, the third largest telecom operator which has been trying hard for a long time to stabilise financially, has decided to raise Rs 18,000 crore through a share sale, the biggest ever follow-on public offer to date in India. The FPO will open for subscription on April 18 and close on April 22. The Vodafone Idea FPO comprises only a fresh issue component of over 1,636 crore equity shares by the company at the upper price band, with no offer-for-sale portion. The price band has been fixed at Rs 10-11 per share, while the participants in the issue can bid for a minimum of 1,298 equity shares and in multiples of 1,298 shares thereafter. In the SME segment, the refined rice bran oil producer and distributor is going to launch its initial public offering (IPO) for subscription on April 15, with a price band at Rs 80-85 per share. The company intends to raise Rs 50.27 crore through IPO of 59.13 lakh equity shares comprising only a fresh issue component. The last day for bidding the issue will be April 18. The gourmet bakeries and patisseries chain that operates under the Birdy's brand will also open its IPO during the same period i.e. April 15-18, with a price at Rs 120 per share. The company is going to raise Rs 16.47 crore via fixed price issue that consists of only a fresh issue portion. Greenhitech Ventures which trades in petroleum-based products will close its Rs 6.3 crore public issue on April 16. It is also a fixed-price IPO with an issue price at Rs 50 per share. The offer was opened on April 12. The market will see two listings both from the SME segment. DCG Wires and Cables, as well as Teerth Gopicon both will debut on the NSE Emerge on April 16, after raising Rs 49.99 crore and Rs 44.4 crore via IPOs last week. The DCG Wires and Cables IPO was subscribed 15.82 times, and Teerth Gopicon public issue 67.2 times during April 8-10.

author: Kamaron McNair
title: MAP: Median annual income in every U.S. state - CNBC
mainText: In 2023, the median annual wage for all U.S. workers was $48,060, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. This means that in about half of the states, Americans earned less than this amount, while in the other half, they earned more. The Northeast and Western regions generally have populations with higher earnings compared to the South and some Midwest states. Massachusetts has the highest median wage for individual workers at $60,690, while Mississippi has the lowest at $37,500. Here are the median annual wages for workers in every state: Alabama: $41,350, Alaska: $56,140, Arizona: $47,680, Arkansas: $39,060, California: $54,030, Colorado: $54,050, Connecticut: $56,130, Delaware: $49,280, Florida: $45,070, Georgia: $45,480, Hawaii: $50,510, Idaho: $44,240, Illinois: $48,730, Indiana: $45,470, Iowa: $46,460, Kansas: $45,250, Kentucky: $43,730, Louisiana: $41,320, Maine: $47,590, Maryland: $55,810, Massachusetts: $60,690, Michigan: $46,940, Minnesota: $50,880, Mississippi: $37,500, Missouri: $45,080, Montana: $45,690, Nebraska: $46,440, Nevada: $44,810, New Hampshire: $49,980, New Jersey: $54,860, New Mexico: $43,620, New York: $56,840, North Carolina: $45,440, North Dakota: $48,830, Ohio: $46,690, Oklahoma: $41,480, Oregon: $50,010, Pennsylvania: $47,430, Rhode Island: $50,970, South Carolina: $42,220, South Dakota: $43,680, Tennessee: $43,820, Texas: $45,970, Utah: $47,020, Vermont: $49,630, Virginia: $49,920, Washington: $59,920, West Virginia: $39,770, Wisconsin: $47,590, Wyoming: $47,250. Wages typically correlate with the cost of living in each state. Therefore, many of the states where workers earn the most also have the highest cost of living. For example, Massachusetts has the second-highest cost of living in the U.S., while Mississippi has the second-lowest, according to the Missouri Economic Research and Information Center's state-by-state cost of living index.

author: India Today Business Desk
title: TCS announces salary hikes: Here’s what employees can expect - India Today
mainText: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), the largest IT services company in India, has announced its plans for annual salary increases for its employees. The company's Chief HR Officer, Milind Lakkad, stated that the salary hikes will range from 4.5% to 7%, depending on individual performance. Employees who perform exceptionally well can expect increments in the double digits. The company made this announcement on April 12, expressing satisfaction in being able to announce annual increments for their workforce, as they have done consistently every year. In the previous fiscal year, TCS implemented salary increases of 12-15% for outstanding performers. These increments are effective from April 1, 2023. Lakkad also mentioned that while most of the freshers for the fiscal year 2023-24 have been onboarded, some are yet to join. These remaining freshers are expected to be added in the April-June quarter. TCS has planned to recruit a total of 40,000 freshers in FY24. On April 12, TCS reported a 9% increase in consolidated net profit, amounting to Rs 12,434 crore for the fourth quarter of FY24, compared to Rs 11,392 crore in the previous year. Revenue also saw a rise of 3.5% to Rs 61,237 crore in the three months ending March 31, 2024, as per the IT major’s exchange filing on April 12.

author: Subhash Narayan
title: MoRTH looks at record ₹60,000 crore monetization in FY25 | Mint - Mint
mainText: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) plans to raise a record ₹60,000 crore through monetization in the current fiscal year. The focus will be on toll-operate-transfer highways and NHAI InvIT. This ambitious target is part of the national monetization pipeline, aiming to achieve ₹1.6 trillion by FY25. The increased monetization goal for FY25 aims to sustain the momentum achieved in the previous fiscal year, during which ₹38,334 crore were mobilized through Toll-Operate-Transfer (ToT), InvIT, and project-based financing routes. The MoRTH’s strategic approach aims to unlock value from infrastructure assets while addressing the country’s funding requirements for critical road projects. The monetization drive is expected to play a crucial role in India’s infrastructure development and economic growth.

author: Brian Sozzi
title: Why Nvidia's stock sell-off matters and what people are saying about it - Yahoo Finance
mainText: This article discusses the recent sell-off of Nvidia's stock and its implications. The stock of Nvidia, a market favorite, fell into correction territory, defined as a 10% decline from a recent high. At its lowest point during Tuesday's session, the stock was down 12.6% from its March 25 high. It has since recovered a bit to $900 but is still off by 5% from the highs. Wedbush tech analyst Dan Ives views this as a digestion period for Nvidia and nothing more. Bank of America analyst Vivek Arya notes that volatility in Nvidia is nothing new — the current sell-off marks the ninth time the stock has declined 10% or more since ChatGPT was launched back in late 2022. Arya mentioned some market factors such as the recent rise in inflation, volatility (VIX), AI stock fatigue, rotation towards more cyclical sectors and possibly some pruning ahead of upcoming earnings season. On a fundamental basis, there are also concerns around rising competition and reducing lead-times for Nvidia GPU accelerators. The Postal Service has filed a notice of the price hikes with the Postal Regulatory Commission. If approved, the increases would take effect on July 14. The proposed increase for all services would raise mail prices by about 7.8% overall. The Postal Service reported a $6.5 billion net loss in November for the 12 months ending Sept. 30. A decline in the use of first-class mail, to its lowest volume since 1968, was part of the loss. Most people use first-class mail to send letters and to pay bills. The service generated about $24.5 billion, or 31% of postal service revenue in 2023. The price hikes have been part of the service's 10-year Delivering for America plan designed to stabilize the Postal Service financially. The Postal Service expects to generate $44 billion in additional revenue by 2031. Under the proposal, the additional-ounce price for single-piece letters would rise to 28 cents from 24 cents. Post office box rental fees would not change and the cost of postal insurance would decrease by 10 percent. The price of international postcards and international 1-ounce letters will increase by 10 cents each, from $1.55 to $1.65.

As these vehicles traverse city streets and urban environments, they scan road surfaces for signs of distress. Using advanced imaging technology, ARRES Eye identifies surface issues such as cracks, potholes, and other damage. It pinpoints their exact location, evaluates their severity, and prioritizes repair tasks. The collected data is logged into a central database for management. ARRES Prevent, another technology developed by Robotiz3d, combines AI and an unmanned robotic vehicle to tackle potholes head-on. The compact electric robo vehicle patrols roads day and night. It navigates streets independently or under remote human guidance. When ARRES Prevent detects small cracks in road surfaces, it promptly seals them using innovative materials. By preventing water infiltration, it stops potholes from forming due to rain and frost. Real-time repair data is recorded for quality control, ensuring effective maintenance. The prototype of this system has successfully completed its inaugural live trial in the U.K. Robotiz3d developed this autonomous robot in collaboration with the University of Liverpool and Hertfordshire County Council Highways Engineers. As Robotiz3d continues its mission, it’s developing the ARRES Ultra, a robust machine designed for more extensive repairs. The ARRES Ultra will address larger surface cracks and fully grown potholes. Its capabilities include site preparation, precise filling of problem areas, and compacting the repaired surface for a seamless finish.

author: Michael Peck
title: US Army's power to rapidly defeat enemies may be a thing of the past - Business Insider
mainText: The US Army's ability to swiftly overpower adversaries may soon be a relic of the past. The era of rapid infantry and tank advances deep into enemy territory could be ending. An Army veteran suggests that the US Army should be more prepared for battles that resemble those of World War I. He argues that any advancing force must move within a defensive bubble to protect against enemy firepower. Modern weapons have become so precise and deadly that armies may soon be unable to execute rapid maneuvers on the battlefield. Instead, they will slowly advance under the protection of defensive 'bubbles' designed to intercept drones and missiles. This suggests that quick battlefield maneuvers will be replaced by slow, attritional wars where victory is determined by the side with the most firepower and the resources to replace losses. This bleak vision of warfare is more reminiscent of the carnage of World War I than the mechanized blitzkriegs of World War II and Desert Storm, where infantry and armor, supported by airpower, captured vast territories. But it's a future that the West must prepare for, warns Alex Vershinin, a retired US Army lieutenant colonel, in an essay for Britain's Royal United Services Institute think tank. The war in Ukraine has shown that — at least for now — firepower dominates maneuver. Both Russian and Ukrainian forces have learned the hard way that with surveillance and attack drones constantly overhead, emerging from cover is dangerous and slow. Long-range guided missiles and shells can decimate armored columns that dare to break through minefields and layered defenses covered by artillery and airpower. Instead of sweeping offensives, the war in Ukraine has become a largely static conflict where immense preparations are made for attacks that might gain an obscure village or a few square miles of territory before the attacker halts to dig in and regroup. 'It is easier to mass fires than forces,' Vershinin said in the RUSI analysis. 'Deep maneuver, which requires the massing of combat power, is no longer possible because any massed force will be destroyed by indirect fires before it can achieve success in depth. Instead, a ground offensive requires a tight protective bubble to ward off enemy strike systems.' 'Shallow attacks along the forward line of troops are most likely to be successful at an acceptable cost ratio; attempts at deep penetration will be exposed to massed fires the moment they exit the protection of the defensive bubble,' said Vershinin.

The agency stated that Park Bo Ram has been plagued by malicious comments and unconfirmed rumors since her debut. Even now, such fake news targeting her after her passing is a clear act of defamation, akin to killing her twice. If such actions persist, the agency will take strong civil and criminal measures. They will continue to pursue legal actions rigorously after the funeral proceedings.

author: Yahya Salem
title: Faith Ringgold, whose art made quilts a potent canvas, dies at 93 - CNN
mainText: Faith Ringgold, an artist and author renowned for her narrative quilts that combined art with activism, has passed away at the age of 93. Ringgold's death occurred at her home in New Jersey on Saturday. Her impactful legacy of activism and advocacy for diversity and inclusion has left a significant mark on the art world, inspiring many others to use their voice for social change. Born in 1930 in Harlem during the Harlem Renaissance, Ringgold was deeply influenced by the social realities she experienced. Despite the restrictions imposed on women by the City College of New York at the time, Ringgold persisted and managed to study art while primarily enrolled in the school of education. After earning her bachelor's degree in fine art and education in 1955, Ringgold began teaching art in public schools while developing her own art. She later received a master's degree in art from City College in 1959. Her early work was deeply influenced by civil and racial unrest, and had strong political and social undertones. Between 1963 and 1967, Ringgold portrayed fraught race relations in America in a series of paintings titled 'The American People Series.' The final painting of the series, 'American People Series #20: Die,' is a vivid critique of the violent riots of the Civil Rights era. The painting, arguably the series' most famous, graphically depicts a group of men, women and children brutally attacking one another. It is now part of the Museum of Modern Art’s permanent collection. 'I became fascinated with the ability of art to document the time, place, and cultural identity of the artist,' she told the Museum of Modern Art. 'How could I, as an African American woman artist, document what was happening around me?'

title: Justin Bieber and Jaden Smith Bro Out at Coachella, Share Kiss - TMZ
mainText: Justin Bieber and Jaden Smith, two music superstars, had a heartwarming reunion at the 2024 Coachella music festival. title: Olivier Awards red carpet: David Tennant, Sarah Snook and Nicole Scherzinger among stars - BBC.com
mainText: The Olivier Awards, the most prestigious event in UK theatre, took place at London's Royal Albert Hall on Sunday. author: Emily Selleck
title: Ryan Gosling puts ‘Barbie’-inspired spin on Taylor Swift’s ‘All Too Well’ during ‘SNL’ monologue - Page Six
mainText: Ryan Gosling, the actor who played Ken in the 2023 hit movie 'Barbie', hosted the sketch comedy show 'Saturday Night Live' for the third time. During his monologue, he took inspiration from Taylor Swift and performed a 'Barbie'-inspired version of her song 'All Too Well', which he titled 'All Too Well (Ken’s Version)'. author: Daniel Kreps
title: Drake Responds to Rick Ross’ Nose Job Claim, Warns Rapper After Diss, ‘Don’t Worry We’ll Handle It’ - Rolling Stone
mainText: Drake has responded to Rick Ross' diss track claims that he got a nose job and warned of more musical retribution against the rapper in a social media post. Ross unleashed his own Drizzy diss track 'Champagne Moments' soon after Drake’s 'Push Ups (Drop and Give Me 50)' leaked. While the bulk of that track was aimed at Kendrick Lamar and Metro Boomin, Drake also targeted Ross on some bars for intruding on the beef. 'Can’t believe he jumpin’ in,' Drake said of Ross, who is 'turnin’ 50.' 'Every song that made it on the chart, he got from Drizzy,' Drake added. 'Spend that lil’ check you got and stay up out my business.' 'Champagne Moments' quickly followed, with people close to Ross telling DJ Akademiks that Rozay hopped into the studio quickly after the Drake track leaked. On Ross’ diss track, he calls Drake a 'white boy,' claims he stole his flow from Lil Wayne, says he employs ghost writers, and alleges he had cosmetic surgery, notably a nose job. 'That’s why you had an operation to make your nose smaller than your father nose,' Ross rapped. It was that claim that apparently caused concern for Drake’s mom, who wondered why the internet was saying her son 'Aubs' had a nose job. 'I can’t believe you would get one without me, cuz you know I always wanted one,' Drake’s mom texted him. In response, Drake quipped, 'I would have got us a 2 for 1 deal if I went ma.' He continued of the nose job rumors, 'It’s coming from Rick Ross the guy I did songs with he’s gone loopy off the [weight loss drug] Mounjaro he hasn’t eaten in days and it’s turned him angry and racist he’s performing at proms for money it’s bad.' Drake also hinted that his next lyrical salvo will be fired directly at Ross: 'Don’t worry we’ll handle it.' And just to make sure Ross saw the warning, he tagged Rick’s @richforever and said 'You’re one nosey goof.'

author: Meredith Woerner
title: ‘Papyrus 2’: Ryan Gosling Returns for Sequel to Beloved ‘SNL’ Sketch Exploring the ‘Avatar’ Font Obsession - Variety
mainText: Ryan Gosling returned to 'Saturday Night Live' for a sequel to his beloved sketch 'Papyrus'. mainText: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan, the action drama starring Akshay Kumar and Tiger Shroff, has crossed the ₹40 crore mark at the box office in India on its fourth day of release. author: Bobby Oler
title: ‘Saturday Night Live’ spoofs NewsNation town hall - NewsNation Now
mainText: The popular sketch comedy show 'Saturday Night Live' spoofed a NewsNation town hall on artificial intelligence in its latest episode. title: This Week @NASA: Following the Shadow of the Total Solar Eclipse, Astronaut Returns, VIPER Moon Rover - SciTechDaily
mainText: This week at NASA was filled with exciting events. The agency provided extensive coverage of the total solar eclipse on April 8, 2024, from various locations across North America. Views of Earth from a NASA science aircraft and even from the International Space Station showed the Moon's shadow passing over cities and towns situated along the path of totality. author: Srinivasan Sivabalan, Thyagaraju Adinarayan, Alice Gledhill
title: Markets Weigh Risk of Retaliation Cycle Following Iran's Attack - Bloomberg
mainText: The global markets are weighing the risk of a retaliation cycle following Iran's unprecedented attack on Israel. The lackluster price action in oil futures is attributed to expectations that the conflict would remain contained. The potential Israeli response to the assault is now the key uncertainty. Goldman Sachs estimates that oil prices already reflect a $5-to-$10-a-barrel risk premium from downside risks to supply, before the weekend attacks by Iran. Iranian crude production has risen by more than 20% over the past two years to 3.4 million barrels a day, or about 3.3% of global supply. If the market were to price a higher probability of reduced Iran supply, then this could contribute to a higher geopolitical risk premium. ING Groep strategists believe that the market had already priced in some form of attack, while limited damage and no loss of life means the potential for a more measured response from Israel. For oil, the first risk is that oil sanctions are more strictly enforced against Iran, which could see anywhere between 500,000 to 1 million barrels a day of oil supply lost. Other possible outcomes include Israel attacking Iranian energy infrastructure or Iran blocking the Strait of Hormuz. RBC Capital Markets analysts believe that the response from Israel's government to Iran's attack will determine whether the situation leads to a wider war, or whether the risks of escalation abate. A significant Israeli retaliation could trigger a destabilizing cycle. However, if Israel stands down or carries out a de minimis response, it seems that Iran might very well take the opportunity to return this war to the shadows.

author: Manjiri Joshi, Aman Sharma
title: ‘Modi Ki Guarantee’ & No Doles for BJP; Caste & Cash for Congress | Decoding 2 Lok Sabha Poll Manifestos - News18
mainText: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Congress have released their manifestos for the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, with each party taking a different approach. The BJP's manifesto, titled 'Modi Ki Guarantee', avoids any cash freebies and instead focuses on Prime Minister Narendra Modi's credibility. The manifesto highlights the party's achievements over the past 10 years and promises to fulfill two unfinished agendas from 2019: One Nation, One Election by 2029, and the Uniform Civil Code (UCC). The contentious National Register of Citizens (NRC) does not find mention in this BJP manifesto. On the other hand, the Congress manifesto highlights caste and cash. The party has promised a caste census and Rs 1 lakh a year to poor families in the country. The BJP has sent out a message that its welfare schemes have reached all castes and religions. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also said that the government’s ‘Lakhpati Didi Yojana’ will be extended from one crore to three crore beneficiaries.

author: Rohit
title: Who Was Joel Cauchi? Knifed Six To Death At Sydney Mall, Including Millionaire's Daughter, Pakistani Man - News18
mainText: Joel Cauchi, a 40-year-old Australian from Queensland, has been identified as the man behind a stabbing spree at a Sydney shopping center. Cauchi went on a rampage, killing six people, including the daughter of prominent Australian businessman John Singleton, and injuring at least a dozen others. While Cauchi had no previous criminal record in Queensland, he had had encounters with law enforcement due to mental health issues. The exact motivations for the attack remain unclear, with New South Wales Police Commissioner Karen Webb stating that there is no evidence of ideological motives behind the assault. The absence of a clear motive has deepened the mystery surrounding the incident. New South Wales (NSW) Police are investigating whether Cauchi targeted women but said it was an 'obvious line of inquiry.' The tragedy unfolded swiftly at the bustling shopping center, with Cauchi's frenzied attack claiming the lives of five women and one man, purportedly a security guard attempting to intervene. Among the victims were Dawn Singleton, 25, the daughter of Australian multi-millionaire advertising guru John Singleton, and a 30-year-old Pakistani man who was working as a security guard.

author: Bill Hutchinson, Caterina Andreano, Katrina Stapleton
title: 8-year-old killed, 10 injured in shooting at family gathering in Chicago, police say - ABC News
mainText: A tragic incident occurred in Chicago's South Side, where an 8-year-old girl was killed and at least 10 other people were injured, including a 1-year-old and another 8-year-old, when gunfire broke out at a family gathering. The shooting took place near 52nd St and South Damen Ave at approximately 9:18 p.m. A witness saw a black sedan approach the scene, when shots rang out into the crowd. The victims, who were reportedly standing outside at a family gathering, ranged in age from 1 to 40. The slain victim was identified by her father as 9-year-old Ariana Molina, who police said was shot in the head. Two boys -- a 1 and 7-year-old, were critically injured after being shot multiple times. All victims were escorted to local hospitals around the area by the Chicago Fire Department. Deputy Chief Don Jerome of the Chicago Police Department stated that the shooting was likely gang-related and was not a random act of violence. Detectives are still investigating the incident and no arrests have been made.

author: Elizabeth Stanton
title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Coachella date night sees them getting cozy backstage - Fox News
mainText: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce, the Kansas City Chiefs' tight end, were spotted getting cozy backstage at the Coachella music festival on Saturday night. The couple, who have been dating since last summer, were seen walking hand in hand through the crowd. Swift was dressed in black shorts with a black top and jacket, and wore a baseball cap in support of Kelce's podcast, 'New Heights'. Kelce was casually dressed in blue and white striped pants, a flannel shirt over a white t-shirt, a bandana, and a 'Happy Gilmore' baseball cap. The couple were also seen enjoying a performance by the band Bleachers, led by Swift's friend and collaborator Jack Antonoff. Swift was photographed laughing as Kelce leaned in close. Fans posted numerous videos of the couple, including one of them dancing together while watching a set by Dom Dolla, and another of them sharing a kiss during the Bleachers performance. Swift is currently on a break from her 'Eras' world tour, with her last stop being in Singapore in March. That same month, the singer and the NFL star were spotted on a romantic getaway in the Bahamas. Kelce has previously joked about his relationship with Swift on his podcast, stating that he wasn't sure how he convinced her to start dating him, as she wasn't into sports.

author: MJ Lee, Kevin Liptak, Priscilla Alvarez
title: Biden tells Netanyahu US will not participate in any counter-strike against Iran - CNN
mainText: On April 14, 2024, Iran launched an unprecedented wave of strikes towards Israel, which lasted about five hours. This attack was in retaliation for a deadly Israeli strike on the Iranian consulate in Damascus, Syria, earlier this month. The Biden administration reported that almost all of the drones and missiles – including more than 100 ballistic missiles – launched at Israel by Iran have been intercepted. US President Joe Biden, in a phone call with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, stated that Israel should consider the night a victory as the current US assessment is that Iran’s attacks had been largely unsuccessful and demonstrated Israel’s superior military capability. US Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin has asked his Israeli counterpart, Yoav Gallant, to notify the US ahead of any potential response to the Iranian attack. The Israeli security cabinet has authorized the three-man war cabinet to decide on Israel’s response. There have been no reports of injuries suffered directly through Iranian strikes, according to Israel’s emergency service. However, a 7-year-old girl was severely injured by shrapnel from an interceptor missile while 31 people were treated for minor injuries or panic attacks. Biden will meet with G7 leaders Sunday “to coordinate a united diplomatic response to Iran’s brazen attack,” according to a statement released by the White House. The US will not participate in any offensive operations against Iran, Biden has made clear to Netanyahu. Earlier this month, an airstrike destroyed Iran's consulate building in Damascus, Syria, and killed seven Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps officials — including top commanders, according to Iranian officials and state-affiliated media. The foreign ministers of Iran and Syria accused Israel of authoring the attack. Iran vowed to retaliate.

author: Michel Durant
title: Barcelona midfielder congratulates Bayer Leverkusen after historic Bundesliga triumph - Barca Universal
mainText: Bayer Leverkusen has made history by winning the Bundesliga for the first time ever. This remarkable achievement was under the guidance of Xabi Alonso, who was briefly linked with the Barcelona managerial job. Bayer Leverkusen's dream campaign saw them dethrone Bayern Munich and secure the Bundesliga title with five matches still to be played. The title was clinched after a 5-0 victory over Werder Bremen, with Florian Wirtz, a long-term target for Barça, scoring a hat-trick. Barcelona midfielder Ilkay Gundogan, who himself has won the Bundesliga with Borussia Dortmund in 2011/12, took to social media to congratulate Xabi Alonso and his team on their success. Gundogan emphasized that Bayer Leverkusen were the deserving winners this season. He expressed his excitement about the team's potential in the UCL if they continue to play as they have. Despite the celebrations, Gundogan and the rest of the Barcelona squad are focused on a crucial week ahead with season-defining fixtures against PSG (UCL) and Real Madrid (La Liga) over the next seven days.

author: Bruce Haring
title: L.A. County Public Health Warns About Traveler With Measles Visiting Local Attractions, Including Universal Studios And Santa Monica Pier - Deadline
mainText: Los Angeles County health officials have issued a warning about a traveler with measles who visited several locations in the county between March 30 and April 1. The Los Angeles County Department of Public Health received notification from the California Department of Public Health about the disease carrier. The traveler, who is not a resident, visited nearly a dozen locations during those three days, primarily in Universal City and at the Sheraton hotel on West Century Boulevard near L.A. International Airport. The individual visited Universal’s trolley and several rides, the Sheraton’s gym, and local restaurants. Other possible exposure locations are still under investigation. Health officials have advised anyone who visited the exposure locations on the specified days to confirm they’ve been vaccinated against measles. 'Measles is spread by air and by direct contact even before you know you have it and can lead to severe disease,' Los Angeles County Health Officer Muntu Davis said in a news release, adding that the disease 'is highly contagious for those who are not immune to it.' Symptoms can appear as far out as three weeks after exposure.

author: Pamela McClintock
title: Box Office: Alex Garland’s ‘Civil War’ Opens No. 1 With History-Making $25.7M for A24 - Hollywood Reporter
mainText: Alex Garland's dystopian action film 'Civil War' has taken the domestic box office by storm, opening with a record-breaking $25.7 million. This achievement marks the highest opening ever for A24, surpassing expectations. The film, which cost $50 million to produce, portrays a divided America and represents a significant leap for A24 as it ventures into producing larger-scale movies. Despite mixed reviews from moviegoers, who gave it a B- CinemaScore, the film's audience was predominantly male, accounting for 73 percent of viewers. The film benefited from Imax screenings, which contributed over 16 percent of the gross. The plot revolves around a wartime photojournalist, played by Kirsten Dunst, and her colleagues navigating a hostile United States torn apart under the rule of a three-term president, portrayed by Nick Offerman. The film avoids typical political divisions and leaves the reasons behind the conflict largely unexplained. The timing of 'Civil War's' release is notable, coinciding with a contentious election year in which President Biden and former President Trump are the leading candidates for their respective parties, with Trump seeking a return to the White House. Garland stated at a SXSW panel following the film's premiere that the release of 'Civil War' was appropriate given the ongoing heated political discourse in the country.

author: Rapid Recap Team
title: Masters 2024: Tiger Woods finishes 100th round at Augusta National with worst score to par in major career - CBS Sports
mainText: Tiger Woods, the five-time champion, played his 100th round in competition at Augusta National Golf Club during the Masters 2024. Unfortunately, he finished the tournament with a score of 16 over par, marking the worst score to par in his major career and the second-worst score to par as a professional. Despite this, Woods managed to secure the longest made cut streak in Masters history on Friday, marking his 24th consecutive weekend appearance. His performance started off strong, with a birdie on the par-5 2nd hole, but mistakes soon began to pile up. A bogey on No. 3 and a triple-bogey 7 on the 5th hole were among the low points. Despite these setbacks, Woods managed to maintain a steady performance with eight straight pars. However, a bogey on the par-5 15th hole put him at 5 over on the day. He finished the round with a score of 77. As he walked off the green on the 16th hole, Woods paid respect to CBS broadcaster Verne Lundquist, who was calling his final event at Augusta National.

author: PTI
title: Cong names candidates for 6 LS seats in Punjab, fields Charanjit Channi from Jalandhar - Hindustan Times
mainText: The Congress party has announced its candidates for six Lok Sabha seats in Punjab. The list includes former Chief Minister Charanjit Singh Channi, two sitting MPs, an MLA, and a former MP. Channi has been fielded from the Jalandhar seat. The other candidates include sitting MPs Gurjeet Singh Aujla and Amar Singh from the Amritsar and Fatehgarh Sahib seats respectively. The Congress has also nominated MLA Sukhpal Singh Khaira from the Sangrur Lok Sabha seat, former MP Dharamvira Gandhi from Patiala, and former MLA Jeet Mohinder Sidhu from Bathinda. The polling for all 13 Lok Sabha seats in the state will take place in the last phase on June 1. Despite opposition from Phillaur MLA Vikramjit Singh Chaudhary, the Congress has decided to bet on Channi from the Jalandhar seat. Chaudhary had even resigned as the party’s chief whip in the Punjab Assembly a few days ago. Channi belongs to the Scheduled Castes community, which constitutes nearly 32 percent of Punjab's population. He served as the Chief Minister of Punjab in 2021 after the Congress replaced Amarinder Singh with him. The BJP has fielded sitting MP Sushil Rinku from the Jalandhar seat. The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) is yet to name its candidate, but former Akali MLA Pawan Kumar Tinu, who joined the party on Sunday, is likely to be the party's nominee.

mainText: Liverpool's season is starting to unravel and manager Jurgen Klopp is at a loss to explain why. A 1-0 loss at home to Crystal Palace damaged Liverpool's Premier League title challenge on Sunday, three days after a 3-0 defeat to Atalanta at Anfield in the first leg of the Europa League quarterfinals. title: Randeep Hooda's "Karma" Remark After Sarabjit Singh's Killer Gunned Down - NDTV
mainText: Actor Randeep Hooda, who portrayed Sarabjit Singh in the 2016 biographical drama 'Sarbjit', expressed his belief in karma after learning about the death of Sarabjit Singh's killer. Unidentified gunmen killed Amir Tanba, who was responsible for the killing of Sarabjit Singh in Lahore's Kot Lakhpat Jail in 2013. The killing of Amir Tanba is seen as a revenge killing done by hired killers. Hooda, who had attended the last rites of Sarabjit's sister Dalbir Kaur who died in 2022, said it's all about Karma. He wondered what Dalbir Kaur would have felt upon hearing about the attacker being killed. He believed that she would have felt some justice served after she fought for years to get him. Hooda also mentioned that they would soon call Sarabjit's daughters and have a chat with them. He reiterated that karma does catch up even if through unknown men.

author: Rafa Honigstein and Seb Stafford-Bloor
title: How Bayer Leverkusen won the Bundesliga: Alonso magic, breaking up cliques and clever transfers - The Athletic
mainText: Bayer Leverkusen, under the guidance of Xabi Alonso, has achieved an extraordinary feat by winning the Bundesliga for the first time in the club's history. This victory was not just a result of a single season's effort but a culmination of strategic planning, breaking up cliques within the team, and making clever transfers. Alonso, who took charge in October 2022, has overseen a remarkable turnaround at Bayer Leverkusen. The team extended their unbeaten record to 43 games in the 2023/24 season, surpassing the previous record held by Hansi Flick’s Bayern Munich team of 2020 and 2021. This unbeaten streak was achieved within a single campaign, which is another remarkable fact about Die Werkself's performance. The team's incredible run included a derby win at Cologne, a dramatic late draw in their Europa League round of 16 first leg away at Qarabağ, a 2-0 success over Wolfsburg, an amazing comeback to win at home to Qarabağ, and then see off Freiburg 3-2 on Matchday 26. The late drama continued the following game as they came from behind in the 88th minute to snatch victory at home to Hoffenheim and move 13 points clear of defending champions Bayern in their unrelenting pursuit of a maiden Bundesliga title. The team's points and goals tallies (79 and 73, respectively) are club records at this stage of a league season. Bayer Leverkusen's only previous major honours were the 1987/88 UEFA Cup and 1992/93 DFB Cup. They are five-time Bundesliga, three-time DFB Cup and one-time UEFA Champions League runners-up. However, with this astounding victory, Alonso’s class of 2023/24 has successfully shaken off the unwanted ‘Neverkusen’ and ‘Eternal Bridesmaids’ nicknames.

title: NASA's largest spacecraft, Europa Clipper, to find if Jupiter's icy moon could support life: Explained | Mint - Mint
mainText: NASA's largest spacecraft, the Europa Clipper, is set to explore Jupiter's moon Europa, which is considered one of the most promising potentially habitable environments in the solar system. The spacecraft, spanning more than 100 ft with its massive solar arrays deployed, is the largest that NASA has ever built for a planetary mission. The mission aims to determine if Europa, believed to contain a deep internal ocean beneath an outer ice shell, has conditions that could be suitable for life. The spacecraft is scheduled to reach Jupiter in 2030 and will conduct about 50 flybys of Europa. High-energy particles around Jupiter generate chemical compounds on the moons’ surfaces that living things might find useful. However, the outer ice shell of both moons is probably 100 miles thick, and neither moon shows signs of geologic activity that might transport those compounds to their oceans.

title: 10 walking mistakes people often make - The Times of India
mainText: Walking seems like a simple exercise, but is often done incorrectly, leading to potential harmful outcomes. Here are the 10 most common walking mistakes made by people: 1. Looking down: Gazing at the ground while walking can strain your neck and cause swelling. Maintain a straight-ahead gaze to ensure proper alignment and avoid eye strain and trip hazards. 2. Skipping rest days: Rest is crucial for muscle recovery and preventing burnout. Incorporate rest days into your walking routine to promote relaxation and reduce stress. 3. Skipping proper meals: Missing nutritious meals can result in low energy levels and decreased performance during physical activities. 4. Ignoring pain: Pay attention to signs of fatigue and discomfort during walks. Address pain promptly to prevent long-term consequences. 5. Overstriding: Taking overly long steps strains muscles and joints, negatively impacting walking form and increasing the risk of injury. 6. Not using arms: Swing your arms while walking to improve balance, engage more muscles, and promote better posture. 7. Not warming up: Proper warm-up reduces the risk of muscle strain and enhances flexibility and blood flow. 8. Not hydrating: Dehydration affects performance and increases the risk of heatstroke. Stay hydrated during walks. 9. Incorrect footwear: Ill-fitting or unsupportive shoes can lead to blisters, foot pain, joint strain, and poor alignment. 10. Poor posture: Walking with tense shoulders or a hunched back can cause muscle soreness, breathing difficulties, and fatigue. Remember these tips to maximize the benefits of walking and maintain overall health and well-being.

author: saumya pandey
title: Seafood Consumption Linked To Increased Exposure To Chemicals | TheHealthSite.com - TheHealthSite
mainText: The study underscores the importance of understanding and addressing the risks associated with PFAS exposure through seafood consumption. Consuming seafood, a staple in many diets may pose risks due to potential exposure to perfluoroalkyl and poly-fluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), known as "forever chemicals." These toxic compounds, found in marine species, can have detrimental effects on human health, necessitating a closer examination of seafood consumption habits. The study emphasizes the necessity for stricter public health guidelines regarding seafood consumption to mitigate PFAS exposure, particularly in coastal regions like New England. Balancing the nutritional benefits of seafood with the associated risks of PFAS exposure is crucial, especially for vulnerable populations such as pregnant individuals and children. A Dartmouth-led investigation paired PFAS concentration analysis in fresh seafood with a statewide survey of eating habits in New Hampshire. The study aimed to fill a knowledge gap regarding PFAS levels in marine species, considering the high seafood consumption rates in New England. PFAS, prevalent in consumer products, soil, water, and wildlife, pose significant health risks, including cancer, reproductive disorders, and thyroid abnormalities. The persistent nature of PFAS makes them a global environmental challenge, necessitating comprehensive research and mitigation efforts. Shrimp and lobster exhibited the highest PFAS concentrations among the tested marine species, underscoring the need for awareness and regulation. The prevalence of PFAS in the marine environment complicates pinpointing specific sources of contamination and understanding its impact on seafood. A survey of New Hampshire residents revealed high seafood consumption rates, particularly among coastal communities. Despite variations in consumption habits based on income and geography, seafood remains a dietary staple for many individuals across demographic groups. Unlike mercury and other contaminants, there are no established safety guidelines for PFAS in seafood consumption. Establishing such guidelines is crucial to safeguarding public health, especially for vulnerable populations, and ensuring informed dietary choices. The study highlights the importance of developing seafood consumption advisories tailored to PFAS exposure risks, ensuring that individuals can enjoy the health benefits of seafood while minimizing potential harm. Protective measures should consider the diverse dietary habits and nutritional needs of different population groups.

author: Dr Sunita Dube, ET HealthWorld
title: Know Everything About Breast Imaging - ETHealthWorld
mainText: The global market for Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the medical devices industry is set to grow at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 29.1 per cent from $336 million in 2023 to $1.2 billion in 2027, according to a report released on Wednesday. The report by GlobalData, a data and analytics company, showed that it’s driven by the demand for healthcare systems to reduce time, costs, and missed detections when diagnosing a growing number of patients with complex profiles. 'A common use of AI in healthcare has been in diagnostic settings, where the speed and accuracy of diagnosing difficult-to-identify image abnormalities by the human eye are flagged by AI algorithms,' said Brian Hicks, Senior Analyst of Medical Devices at GlobalData, in a statement. 'The consequence of this is that more patient profiles can be reviewed while also minimising any potential misdiagnoses,' he added. The report reveals that the underlying technology that drives this trend is referred to as computer vision, and its diagnostic applications are leveraged by wide-ranging specialists. The use of AI in decreasing error rates of cancer detection has already been well demonstrated, where one study as far back as 2016 showed that pathologists who had utilised AI in detecting cancer-positive lymph nodes had reduced their error rate from 3.4 per cent to 0.5 per cent. 'Furthermore, due to the ability of AI to flag potential indication-positive cases in a fraction of the time it takes for physicians, with similar if not greater accuracy, many additional patient profiles can be reviewed with unprecedented speed,' Hicks said. Various companies are specialising in medical imaging using AI and its associated deep learning technology. GlobalData research reveals that most of the AI-related investments in the medical industry are poured into those within the imaging and diagnostic spaces, as more traditional hardware and surgical instrument-focused MedTech companies have relatively limited opportunities to incorporate such technologies into their products. 'The importance of early detection of any indication cannot be understated; thus, the ability for AI to improve and analyse difficult-to-detect tissue abnormalities, symptoms, and complex patient profiles will enable earlier interventions and patient outcome,' Hicks said.
